### 8. Mitigation of Impacts from Access Restrictions

103. Avoiding impacts by linking to exclusion zones targeted for restoration which exhibit a high degree of dependency on poor and vulnerable affected persons, as these sites tend to be overused and thus display a considerable degree of degradation. In order to meet both, the landscape restoration and livelihoods improvement project will seek to restrict damaging practices while providing ways and means for the improvement of land use practices.

104. Avoiding impacts by linking to omit locations with high dependency of especially poor and vulnerable resource users who are identified in the SIS as being among their primary participants. The project measures will entail a combination of (i) regulation of access to resources, (ii) promotion of alternative and economically viable resource or resource locations, and (iii) the reduction of demand on resources by promoting alternative livelihoods.

105. Alternative means of livelihood generation may require (iv) alternative means of livelihood generation or (v) subsiding poor and vulnerable affected persons who are identified in the SIS as being among their primary participants. The project measures will entail a combination of (i) regulation of access to resources, (ii) promotion of alternative and economically viable resource or resource locations, and (iii) the reduction of demand on resources by promoting alternative livelihoods.

106. Given that the restoration and livelihood improvement project involves the rehabilitation of potentially complex land use and livelihood systems which involves the consideration of various time factors, both seasonal and over the short- to medium-term future, which can accomplish sustaining the livelihoods of PAPs and the landscape in general.

107. This will ensure that the project measures are sustainable, since resource users are fully engaged and entitled to project benefits and mitigation measures, as these would otherwise

Given the current state of de-adoption it does not provide more resources to local communities and as such does not offer real income to the local population, except for the use of some areas for controlled grazing. It should be noted that the establishment of buffer zones and land-use agreements with the CVCs will not necessarily cause increased adversity for vulnerable groups in terms of their access to resource assets. On the contrary, by ensuring sustainable management of the buffer zone area, this will provide a more stable income source for local communities through controlled and sustainable access to resources in the medium and long term. The details of land use, timeframe, and other aspects are currently being negotiated with the CVCs at the subproject level. It will be ensured that certain activities such as harvesting of honey and (controlled) grazing can be allowed

# 8.1.3. Direct and indirect employment opportunities through reforestation works

The project will provide direct employment opportunities for restoration works on public lands (Alaguer buffer zone, lake and river shoreline and roadside plantations and state and district-owned tree plantations). The project will also provide indirect employment opportunities by contracting forestry service providers, including local small contractors, who will hire labour from local communities to carry out planting (in particular in the buffer zone). The feasibility study has estimated the following employment needs:

- Lake and river shoreline and roadside plantations (Activity 4.1.3): 700 laborers
- Alaguer buffer zone (Activity 4.2.1): 700 laborers
- Scale-up climate resilient silvopastoral operations (Output 1.3.1): 100 laborers
- Restoration of district owned tree plantations (Activity 1.2.3): 308 local small contractors plus 700 laborers for the buffer zone
- Restoration of State-owned district tree plantation (Activity 1.2.2): 500 permanent staff of 20 contractors plus 10,000 laborers

For the restoration of the Alaguer buffer zone, as well as the lake and river shoreline and roadside plantations, Community Forest Councils (CFCs) will be established as described above. Forestry service providers will be engaged by the Project to ensure the proper seedling preparation and planting. The service providers will also provide technical assistance in the selection of appropriate tree species for local communities and the local authorities. Priority will be given to vulnerable groups, including women and people with disabilities or restrictions. The latter will be determined based on the social impact assessment as discussed in section 7 above.

## 8.1.4. Improvement of private tree plantations

Activity 1.2.3 aims to support smallholders who individually own only very small plots to restore areas of any size, including degraded land, and ensure their sustainable management under private Forest Management Units (FMU) according to approved simplified forest management plans (SFMF) and through joint-venture agreements with the project. The project will provide technical assistance in order to develop necessary organizational and technical capacities. The project will assume the main part of the costs for restoration works (plantation) which will be tendered to the forest operators. The FMUs will provide their own resources, including land tenure rights, seedlings, and other inputs such as water (if needed), government (e.g., electrical poles, etc.). This initiative is expected to lead to productivity enhancements and economic benefits for smallholders through increased tree cover, improved soil fertility, and the reduction of pressure on resources in surrounding areas which may come under land use restrictions.

## 8.1.5. Alternative income opportunities

The interventions under outputs 1.1, 2.2 and 2.3 aim to support small holders and households to transition from subsistence farming to commercial production, including improved access to financial services, such as savings, credit and financial literacy, and to increase beneficiaries' productive assets and market participation through the integration of farmers into existing Farmer Forest Producer Organizations (FFPO) or, where appropriate, forming new ones. The project will also support the development of value chains for tree products which have been selected as these represent common livelihood activities also practiced by poorer households with limited access to land. In particular, the bee product value chain with activities, such as beekeeping operations and branding of honey and other bee products is expected to be developed.

Alternative income opportunities are expected both through employment opportunities provided by the micro-enterprises acting within these value chains or through self-employment and business creation

activities. Micro-enterprises can supplement seasonal agricultural incomes and/or link smallholders to local markets through the sale and exchange of products. For local tree seed enterprises and seedling nurseries the project will provide technical assistance in the form of training and inputs.

118. It needs to be emphasized that the possibility of capture of these project benefits by better-off and well-connected sections of the communities in the subproject areas needs to be checked and that appropriate measures for restrictions on access to resources and land use are guaranteed access to respective project benefits.

### 8.1.6. Other mitigation measures

119. Equitable distribution within communities lacks appropriate assets, such as sufficient titled land or seed, to enable their participation in sustainable livelihood generation in the planned activities under the project benefits; alternative means are required to provide viable mitigation measures to these PAPs. The project will therefore need to establish a number of groups that will be responsible for providing training to establish cultivation of vegetable crops interplanted with tree crops, or fuelwood plantations on state land adjacent to their communities. These groups would also be responsible for the maintenance of soil restoration and sustainable management practices. These groups would require both capacity building and access to inputs, credit and markets comparable to project provisions for small holders and plantation owners.

120. All mitigation plans will need to be based on the comprehensive analysis of the local ecosystems and livelihoods in the subproject areas that are required to achieve a viable model of regulated access to existing resources, the provision of alternative resources and the facilitation of altogether different livelihood activities.

### 8.3. Viability of livelihood restoration measures

121. It will be important to assess the viability of the proposed mitigation measures to ensure that these are capable of sustaining livelihood in the long term. This would entail an analysis of the accessibility and appropriateness of alternative resources, the availability of credit supply chains and of the skills of the PAPs targeted to adopt these alternative income generation activities.

122. It must be considered that for example the overproduction of honey and bees after adoption by many project households is a result of the lack of market access and the absence of transport links. The switch to stock breeding new lines may undermine production and the absence of affordable transport may hinder the marketing of livestock. This analysis will therefore need to consider whether all proposed livelihood activities will be implemented with the required enabling conditions. Careful consideration must also be taken to fully understand the feasibility of proposed and adopted livelihood improvement measures and ensure adequate access to alternative livelihood sources and thus their viability.

Based on the inventory of losses and affected persons and the selection of preferred feasible mitigation measures, the project will also need to identify the appropriate PAPs in each subproject area. ## 8.4. Free, prior, and informed consent

126. Once individual agreements on all mitigation measures for each household of PAPs under a subproject have been established through the participatory negotiation process, a final plenary meeting among the PAPs, project representatives, and relevant local government authorities will be held to sign off on the Project EEI and the relevant local government authorities, will be held in which the free, prior, and informed consent of the PAPs with the restrictions of access and the provisions of the specified mitigation measures is requested. The minutes of this meeting will be recorded and a copy provided to the PAPs. A summary report of the event will be prepared. The FPIC of the PAPs will also be stated in a written document within both the local government authorities and the Project EEI, and shared with the PAPs and management representatives of the Project EEI and the relevant local government authorities.

## 9. Budget for Assessment and Mitigation of Access Restrictions

127. The full cost of the preparation and implementation of the AR Action Plan for each relevant subproject is an integral part of the Project Implementation Cost (PIC). This includes, inter alia, the SOA, as well as administration, monitoring, and evaluation, is covered under the budget of the EMF. The cost of the implementation of the AR Action Plan, including compensation and livelihood rehabilitation will be covered under each subproject. The subject AR Action Plan will present a budget for the cost of its implementation.

128. As the majority of mitigation measures for the impacts of access restriction may be expected to be planned and implemented in advance of project activities, it is anticipated that the costs associated with their implementation are already accounted for under the general cost for project activities and included in the overall Project Implementation Cost (PIC). The cost of the preparation and implementation of AR Action Plan implementation will also be covered under the general project budget for these activities.

129. However, any AR Action Plan implementation costs due to additional measures not covered under present arrangements may be required as part of the AR Action Plan. These costs are included in the cost of all additional compensation and livelihood restoration. Each AR Action Plan budget will be presented in table format with a breakdown by type of mitigation measure and the total cost for each line item of the entitlement matrix. The budget aggregates for each type of loss to the costs for all respective displaced persons, households or entities identified in the AR Action Plan impact assessment. The budget headings include: number of beneficiaries of mitigation entitlements; respective unit rate; numbers of units and total cost for each mitigation measure.

## 10. Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting Arrangements

### 130. Monitoring of the planning and implementation of access restrictions and their mitigation are part of the ESMP monitoring, which is integrated into the monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) system of the AR Action Plans. The EEs will be responsible for (i) the overall coordination of the implementation of all activities and measures of all subproject AR Action Plans, following up on the requirements of the AR Action Plan; (ii) ensuring that the Lead EEU monitors the progress of implementation of the required actions under an AR Action Plan; and (iii) output monitoring of the progress of implementation of the required mitigation measures, i.e., the provision of mitigation entitlements to the displaced PAPs. The EEs will also be responsible for providing regular updates on the status of the Lead EEU for the respective subproject and the IUCN M&E/Safeguards Officer for each subproject with an AR Action Plan.

### 131. If identifying any non-compliance with the AR Action Plans or other critical issues during their implementation, a Corrective Action Plan will be prepared for each respective subproject by the EEs in consultation with the Lead EEU and IUCN M&E/Safeguards Officer. The plan will address the non-implementation of all requirements of the AR Action Plan, as well as necessary adaptations of the Action Plan to ensure that the mitigation entitlements are provided on time and in full. The implementation of the corrective actions will be monitored until the full resolution of all issues addressed by the Corrective Action Plan and assessed during the evaluation of AR Implementation.

### 132. The Lead EEU, IUCN M&E/Safeguards Officer, and EEs will monitor the PAPs’ adherence with respect to the required actions and delivery of mitigation entitlements and assess their impact on the livelihoods of the PAPs. The impacts will be assessed against the baseline data generated by the census and socio-economic survey conducted in 2015 as well as the baseline data from the respective AR Action Plan interim and final evaluation reports of the PMU.

### 133. If the evaluation identifies any compliance issues or adverse impacts on the livelihoods of the PAPs, the internal review committee will prepare a Corrective Action Plan to address these issues. The implementation of the Corrective Action Plan will be monitored and evaluated until the full resolution of all issues identified in the plan.

### 134. All monitoring and evaluation activities concerning the implementation of AR Action Plans will be undertaken with the engagement of the relevant stakeholders, especially the persons affected by AR, to receive their feedback and consider their concerns.

1.3 Impumu umohinga wategwe

Uyu mushinga uganjije kweneka no kunzo uburyo bwiza bw'umicungire y'ubutaka mu kubungabunga ibidikizhe kongera umusoro na gutoza imberero myija. Hitzwe ko bi bizaifaha kongera umusuro ukomuka ku mashyamwa no kutona ibicawu bibahaje, kongera umusuro, kwihaza mu biribwa, ndetse no gufira abaturage kubona ibicawu mu buryo bhendutse binuzwe cyane cmu y'ukubazogela Imburaba zironderesa icumana. Gusa birishokoda ku mo ghe cuco gashyuru ba bikorwa uyu mushinga, hai bikorwa bidushora kugira inguruka zoohene ku iyangirwa ny'ibidikizhe ndetse zikate zanangambele imbereho myija y'abaturage by'umwahariko abafite amikoro makie. Ni muni uneo nwege, hatugowe iyi gahunda igamije gumukura inguruka zatewa e bikorwa by'uyu mushinga halu mu kubungabunga ibidikizhe cyane ku mikero myija y'utaurage.

Iyi galuhanda iri mu ndimi izicyongereza n'ikimyamweza izatingazwe ku rubuga na ikigo IUCN ndetse n'ibindi bigo bini biziba bohobwe gushyura mu bikorwa uyu mushinga. By'umwahariko, inyariko iri mu runu rurin'i nyamwezera izigazwe ku batufanabonwebo aho base umohinga uzakowera kugira ngo nabo bazabehe kuyigaze ku bute abo ikiborwa bazokwerena.

##b'amatungo bifite ubudhangawra bukomeye mu guhangana n'tuba kubirango birwaneye kumagara kw'inzuri
kw'ibimera bidasanezwe muri ako gace bigateza iyangiwa ry'urusobe ny'ibinyabuzima muri ako gace.
kwaifashishwa nk'ubwatsi bw'amatungo y'inka ariko nabohe binabasha guhangana n'dhindukira ny'iithe birahodako ko bozabaza kuzara bendi bimera bidasanezwe ari karemo muri ako gace. Gusa, mu kuzura ibyo bimera hazikurwitsa amawelisa y'ikigo mpumatsamhanga cy'amashyamba ICAR afahangwa imama ko mu ritara y'bubirurisabwa bw'a Rwanda hakorembwe ibyito by'amatungo hanyino bitybwa diversifika, Leucania tricrista, Leucania palida, Callimorpha californica and Verminia amorphina. Ibi oyese itago byingira bigana.

3. Ubunyo bwo gukumera ibibazo byavuka mu ishinwamukorwa ry'umushinga

Ici gice kiribanda cyane ku buru bwo guzisuba uwimerweere ubutaka mu itonde rya 1. Hazatoranywa hashingweye ku bibazo byahiyare hafite bijanye n'inganuka z'ihindagurika ny'ikikire.

3.1 Guhimo akahorewe imishinga

Umsingiha uzakarena uyemukariko mu dduwemo yu muke duutsenye abataffe bafite amikoro muke mu turunde twintara y'ibirurasiyabura. Gutanyana utwo abe duto u abaceuta bubuzasobwa uwimerweere bizagendera ku bibazo bitandukanye buru. Iziwumu ry'uburo butaka rizikawa hakesorutye byibwe RDAM mu mpyine y'ingoroyekeza. Ibindi bizangenderawulo mu gihumira ubatuka buzakoreramo lyo mishanga byumwikyemweho n'aibafazanyabokore bose bazaha bahurije muri inyo suzuma rigena akahawe kujya umushinga. Gahunda yo guhito abe gukora imishinga iri mu mbonerahene ya 3.

Imbonerahene ingaragazwa ubuzyo imisingha izayihiywoho.

3.2 Isuzuma ry'imberehe y'ubatagarwe

Ibice bizakoreramo ni bemara gutanyora, hazakora isuzuma ryishye rya buri gice kugira ngo hamenyamene amakuru y'ibabare y'ubatagarwe. Ibi bizangana ishusho y'iminterere y'ubatagarwe, byo bahuje ndetse n'yabo batandukanyemo. Habazinde ku kurima imeniro dianiriza amahanga hamwe ny'imberehe yabo ku buru byorwa byobohi guhabaye abakamene kusanda abandi ni kukwuga mu burye bw'umwikariko abantu bafite gusa guzo ubushoboro two gukresha iniki mu gutunganya ifunguro. Aya makuru azabo ahaniri muri Munsten y'Ubugutesi by'igihwe ndetse n'ikyo ngi lgihwugishohe. Barinuruhumbarabe nafo icyiziro ururome rukirimo kikazangana y'iibyico binzwedze y'ubudweho. Amakuru azabo hano hitso myino azanirangambo hakorwa isuzuma ry'abakenye kikazandwo korosha atsiko.

3.3 Abaterebwe n'umushinga

Imishinga mito ifite kimwe muri ibi bikorwa bikinburika ritwabo irweba n'ubufasha bw'uyu mushinga:

- Ahakoresewa ingemeye nvamahanga zateza ubutaka bibazo kandi nti u'ubunyo buteguye buhuti bwo gukumera cyangwe guhanhara y'iibyico bibazo byabva biivutse;
- Iroresha ny'uburo twanzaga urwenzu neby'inizimbye, kandi bikaba bohinora kwangisa ubutaka ir'amati), bukanikorera imikorere myito y'uruzindo n'ibirizimbye abantu uwo rusobe rukaba rwatazaka uwimerweere cyangwa rukanahinduka (amashyamba, ibishanga cyangwa ciiburu bikala byatakaza uwimerweere).

3.4.Gusutume ingakuru z'umushanga ku bidukilije no ku mibereho y'abaturage

Impamvu iyi zuroma ni ukugira hoga gusutoobanikwa nibi hari ingakuru mbi zatureka ku mushinga mutso hayunyama ibo nzo nguruka zimenyenekanye habakahaba n'andi masumaza agajime gushyiraho ingamba zo guhangana n'izo nguruka. Isuzuma rishyira buri mushinga mutso mu rwego runika hagendewe ku bwinsi cyangwe ubwice ubungarwa mbi zilwetshweho, nkwezi, izigyererezo, nyisho. Imishinga mitso ifito ingakuru mbi nyisho nta kunga izatware. Isuzuma rikowara hifashishitole uruhungura nebo!izibazo bibazwa bikakanurikirana n'umukumi w'Umushanga wa IUCN uhusimwe ukugenzisiza n'ubuziranenge.

3.5.Isuzume ny'Umushanga n'ingamba zo gukurima

Ni ngombwa gushyiraho ingamba ku mishinga yungarisa ni mu gice cy'imohinda itaparagaza ibayo bwinsi cyangwe imbogamizi nyisho mu rwego rwo gukurima ko hari ikibazo cyaparagara mu ihyinwa mu bikizana ryayo. Ibi ngombwa gakorera hitabaye cyane ku komisa bintekerezo by'abagerewakwoba kw'Umushanga mu buryo bazitugaye hagenewe na none ku ngamba zigaragara mu mbonerahamwe ya 2. Bitewe rimiremere y'ikibazo, hazakenera gukenerwa inyino ndi yihuriye. Ku bikizo bindi bikomeye byavuka, hazakenera umupuzo we mbi bazinane izafite aho thurye n'umushanga.

3.6.ESAM ku mishinga yungarira

Imishinga mitso iparagaza ibayo biko berekana na raporo yiyesengura izaba yakozwe mbere. Ku mishinga ifito amahle mwenho mu kudhara ibayo byo guhura in'mbigomizi mu ihyinwa mikobwera byayo. Ulikuzi wa IUCN uhuire inkurikirana ngencora ry'umishanga afite inangonano zo kukugenda niba nyayo y'igencora yakaroswe ndze ndetse niba raporo patayevo nayo paratoyeze neza. Uyo mukizi kandi agencura ibo byosewe mu rnyi gencura ry'izabazo byasanzekana mu nyandiko y'imbanazikirana, ikuyise mu nyandiko yihuriye igaragano. Ula bidukilije ndetse n'umutokano wa Abantu bitobwaho mu gice cy'inhyirva mikobwera y'umushanga.


---
**Page 405**
---

3.7 Ikurikaniabikowora n'igencura nyishwamukisorwa nya ESMP

Imishinga yose itagaragaza imbogimizi nyisori izakenera ishiyina mu bikorwa ry'ingambia zikubuye mu nyandiko y'umushinga igaragaza uko ibidukikje n'umutekano w'abantu bizabahitwe (ESMP). Unwegu nushyira mu bikorwa umusungura ni aravo kandi rushowise gushyira mu bikorwa imido inishinga minto, ni narwo rutufe mu nhogana ishiyina mu bikorwa ry'ingambia zigembe gukubora bimba byavuka ku moshinga.

Uburyo bwe kugaragaza abo ingamba zo gikumbwa rizege zihiyirwa mu bikorwa, bikorwa n'unwegu rushyira mu bikorwa umusungura. hagegendwe ko nhuziro zigeteyina muti ESMP, byibura mu gihe cy'umwikiziyo izi raporo kandi zisengeserana n'umwikizi wa UHIZI uhozirwe ikurikaniabikowora n'isuzyimyihinga. Urutse guusengura izi raporo kandi, hazajaya hasuzosuzume ubuzinzerange bw'iiziga ngamba.

Bitewe ni'miterere y'ikilabo, unwegu rushowise kukiriana rushobora gugabiro ibigambo byaharanye n'abagenenwabikowora ndetse n'igacu cy'abagabwoho ingakuru n'bikorwa by'umushinga kugarira ngo haksanurove ibitekerero byabo ku buryo babona ingamba zikurima zashoyizweho. Ku moshinga igaragaza ibayo kene, rita kindi kindi ikenerye urutse guza kuyikukirirana mu buryo buhoraho.

4. Ibityanye n'biginiro n'abagenewabikowora, uburyo bwe kugaragaza no Gutanga amakuru ku bitangenda

4.1 Ibiginiro n'abagenenwabikowora

Uburyo bw'inikanirorwa n'abagenenwabikowora bu'mushinga ndetse no gutanga amakuru bitenganywa mu nyandiko yiharwe inebu iti ngingo. Toritanya rya site zisazama muri gahunda z'amushinga zisoanburwa mu gihe cye 3.1 cy'igacu nyandiko. Iki gice kandi ikagaragaze uko imishinga mito mitso ibakonwa. Bitewe n'bikorwa byabozwe ku muri buryingi, umushinga uzagira ubwino bw'misiranyire a abagenenwabikowora bavabo bibazwe kugira ngo hareweze nibo ibikwenye by'ingacu byoziwe byantwiyeho. Abagenenwabikorwa n'triginiro bo bavugwe mu gihe cye 1.1. ni abahimi batu anu habo umushinga uzakorana naboz bizinye binyize mu buryo


---
**Page 406**
---

rusinge bwagutse ndetse no kugera aho batuye mu nwe gutoranya ibikwana bikazorewarewa umushanga.

Abahini! kandi bazagaminiwa mu ghe ogo gutoranya ibikwana by'umushanga bizobanda ku itewa ny'ibiti bvingawe n'imyaka kugira ngo ibitekezozi ritifuzvyo byabu ko mirima yabo ndetse ny'ahao batuye batutsva.

Kuri gice cya 1.2, abagerewakwobwa bibanze no abanasebe bafimwe amayambaya cyangwe imirima (hizemo biti) ogungu abantu bunyika bifuksi kubishoromana imilini. Ubuyoro bwse gukurana n'abo bose ni ubu bukurikira:

- Amayambaya yikirere (igikwora cya 1.2.1): Nk'uko byasobanweve mbere, umushanga uzakwa ibikwana bitangatunyeka byubukuramagula mu nwego two gushikarishwa abagerewakwobwa ko muri binyi bice gufuta no kwegukana amayambaya yose y'akarene

- Gutora amayambaya ya Leta (igikwora cya 1.2.2): Muyakabisa uzafasha ikigo cy'ighugu goshinwe amayambaya (FDR) ndetse ni Uturene mu kubuma umurongo: wo kubaka imikorarine y'abagerewakwobwa ko mu nwego ny'abokurana ndetse no amalampanyi kugira ngo alaka amatamidzira anu ku boso bwe 100.000vya uygirise kikene, harimo r'amalsaperative y'abahisi harimo n'abazense batifite imimba y'ahiyamba ku giti cyahis.

- Izuhawa ry'ubatizvo butso buto (igikwora cya 1.2.3): Muri ki gikuramo, umushanga utifte intego yo gukusa ibasamakurumuri ny'abatizvo rihutembe n'abaturage mu nwego two gutharaha ubutaka bw'abantu ku giti cibyo (impuzandenge za 40 yabutakada, hafi amatanda 160) byingwevye cyinga ubherenyesi ku buhaname bukabikie, bukunze kwabisirwa n'isuri ku buryo bigaragara ko bikenewe kubungabungwa.

Mu gice cya 1.3, abagerewakwobwa bibanze no abantarese b'ababori. Umushanga uzakurana nabo binyuzwe mu gutoranya ibiyonya/ibinuri byabo hageneru ko kugero cyo kwangirika cyaboyo kugira ngo hamenayekene akahanye kwitawubwa kurandzhi anaku. Ku bafunyera n'abaturage, amasite azashyrwaho ubushimbwiri bw'biti azashyrwaho ndetse acungwe n'abaturage uwabwo. Aba batuzvare ni nabo bazake uruhure mu gutoranya ubwoko bw'biti bvingawe n'imyaka biziterwa harimo r'ubatizvo bw'amutangiro.

Ubuyoro bw'mikorarine n'abaturage kwitawonjirwe ku gikwana kiri mu gice cya 1.4 buhingire abanini ku gushyiraho amatanda y'abaturage y'imboni (CVC). Aya matanda azabi agicwe

**Page 407**

**4.2. Gutanga amakuru**

Imishuga ifite ibayo bice in mu nweyo ngo Bw. Ikenera (ESIA) ndetse ny'inyandiko igaragaza uko bidikudike ndetse n'umukutoko w'abantu bitatolwa (EMP). Izahyirya ahagarazia izi nyandiko zose mu mino 30 mbere y'imeyenza ry'umushanga. Izi nyandiko zose zicaba zuri mfu ndimi zicyongerera n'ikenyawanda.Raporo zizayikilirana GCF hakoreshejwe buroyo bw'ikorabana/hageta n'detse n'ubunyaga rwa interenti rwa GCF hagehedewe kuri politiki yo gutanga amakuru ya tsin'i igice yu 7.1 cy'itangwa ry'ahumuru cy'inyandiko ya GCF.

Imishuga ibohatra gutuma hakwemo abaturage, isasaba ibindi bigamiro byahariye n'abagererawakiora by'unamukirano abaguzwe ingaruka ku buryo bataziguye. Ibajnye nuko bici bizikorwa bigaragira mu mugenya 5.

**4.3. Uburo bwo Kuganza ibitengana**

IUCN ifite uburo buzoz bufaha abagererawakiora kugaragaza ibyo batashimwe mu bice byose ibikorwa by'imishuga ya IUCN iherereyemo mu ghe hana hari amahame atubuhirije.


---
**Page 408**
---

Ubunyo bufasha abagenewabikorwa b'umushinga kugarapaza ibyo batimihinye ni ingeni kuwo bufasha mu gatungwe icyore ku bagenewabikorwa ko bazamwe kunda bagafashwa ku ghe mu ghe hari iyo cagurubira. Ubunyo bwe IUCN busonhora neza amahame akurikwiza, inozra zinyawemwo mu kugarapaza ilitengenda ku mushinga , ubunyo bwe gutanga igusibuzo, ndetse r'ubunyo umushingwa ukukorana uko bikorwa.

Umuntu cyangwya unwezo rundwa neumva ko rushobora kugirwaho inguruka z'umushinga ku bonyo bato bintarise. Ku hore amahame amwe ni anwe yinemayeve azhobora kugarapuzza. Umuntu ku ghi cye cyangwya ulitengenye abandu azhobora gutanga ikibazo cye. Icyotakwa bintabo bitagiragira ku nyati kulifunga nito gacino bizahawera. Umieronondo w'abatizyone ibibazo uzinawa kigare igite cyose.

Ubusabe butemwe ne ubi bukurikira:

- Ibibazo bini guhakwirwa ibisubuzo cyangwya ibindi bibibizo abandi bantu batari IUCN cangwya unumidu rwego rutifite aho nuhuriye r'umushinga

- Ibibazo byatanezwe nyuma y'amasi 18 nyuma y'inangira y'umushinga mu ghe iki kibazo gifite inkomoko ku mushinga ariko tanyarimwekenye mbye y'tariki y'inangira y'umushinga

- Ibibazo bintafane isamo n'amategikyo, polisi by'ighuru, keretse guza mu ghe iki kibazo gifite aho ghurure y'amahame ni inkomoko yinendidze ya ESMS ya IUCN

- Ibibazo bintafane isamo n'imicungere y'umutunga n'abakosi ndetse n'imbyeorewe bya IUCN kuko bifite abandu bibarwa.

Inotra ehatu zo gukemura ibibazo cyangwaye

Gukemura neza no gushika umuti w'ikibizo cyatanzowe, bikorerewako rwego mwo hasi hashoboka. Ubunyo bwe IUCN bwo gukemura bidzidzo bushingitse ku ritambwe 3 m'ukico zagaragaweye muru Figure 2. Bitangirwa ku ngwe ruzhinze shiyinwa mubikorwa ry'umushinga hamere n'urwego rundweba n'ikibazo. Aba bafanyana mu kwiga interetse y'ikibazo kunda bigakorwa bose bazishye imbere inyingya bahuriyeho kugira ngo hunikyanire ku byo impande zamokho zhinureyo.

### Imbonerahamwe ya 2: Uburo butatu (3) womenyekirano ibitagendo nezo mu mushinga

Nuwo bishoboka ko ikibazo gishyoba gukumika ku rwego ne'abashyira mu bikorwa umushanga ndetse n'abawenye n'ikibazo, ariko birahoboka cyane ko ibitoro bhoshoda kwanga bikagera ku rundi rwego, bigazaba ko hitabaze ishami rishinze Gukurikirana imishinga nira ku cyycara iyo IUCN ku rwego ne'ighughu.

Mu ghe izi intambo ebyeti rnyo musuroro zitano, ikibazo cyakoherezza ku rundi rwego nesiyumbe nea iUCN (PCMS) gi'ikisimwe ya 3. Yo ghe hagomba guosabunwa ko uburo bwo kumvikanwa impande zombi bwarwi bwakorehejive mberwe mu gushaka umuti w'ikibazo arino ntibugye icyo butago. Mu ghe izibazo cyaba giyekene umwahiko bitewe n'amakuru arimo, uwataseze kigero afite impungurere y'uburoba, intambe za mbere zakeingerezwe, bityo ikibazo kigantagana hakorehejive PCMS.

Ikibazo gitangwa ku PCMS, gitangana hakorehejive uburo butirira:

- **Gukorisha fax to +41 22 999 00 02 (ugakoreheza IUCN, ikicaro gikuru nka adresi); cyangwa**
- **Ugahamagala Tel +41 22 999 02 59.**

Hagendewe ku ntambwe ya mbere, ibibazo bishobora kwakirwa mu magambo ku mukoozi w'umusungu yuri kini site, hakoresheye Telephone cyangwa mu nyandiko igashyirwa mu gasunduro K'bibiterozero cyangwe se ikibazo bibikwa cyatangana hakoresheje email yohereza kuiri PMU cyangwa IUCN.

Unsetse intambwe ya mbere, Intambwe ya kabini PMU cyangwa IUCN (intambwe ya 3), ikindi kintu cy'ingi/nyeri ni ukubaya ikigawenye wo kwandikano nu kubikamo ibibazo bityakirwe. iyi kayi ifasha cyane kubika no kwegwanya ibibazo byatanzowe ndetse n'aho ibibazo bigeze bikemurwa

Inzego igashyira mu bibikora imishinga zifite inshingano zo gutanga ikayi ikubymeto ibibazo byatanzowe, igashykiricwa PMU mu ghe cya buru mid 6.

Abantu bose bantanga ibibazo byabo bakarimana inkabupfu kandi amakuru yabo akabikwa mu ibanga nkamweye. Bunu rwego rushinwehe igashyira mu botsho umushinga ruwa rusudwa gakoroba dibusokya bino mu bakimera kwabishyirayi mu ghe cyangwe, kyalakwa hani bimwe n'ikindi kubiko kubiko yabo cyane, bidzi byo abagorekwa ku neego rwabintse. Bunu rwego bisoko, bibonokwana kwakirwa cyane (PMU) ibatanzowe mid 10. PMU ibohorwa gafashwa na IUCN, ishami nyiro kuvungu ra'ikigihwe. Aba PMU nayo itabishyaje gumekura ibibazo yashykiriyeho, iki kibazo gishyikirye PCMIS mu minsi 20 kugira ngo gisuzumwe ighe bibweta ndetse n'uko bigenda bikubuye mu nyandiko ya IUCN.

Inyakindo yabugenyewenye y'ibibazo iziyashwa mu rurano galokoto ndeto inshingi ahanu hagwenha wa buru wene. Bibazo byabo bishyirayi binyweze n'PMU bikoroma isuzuma nyimbate ndetse n'ikindi nyi gusudutwa ikonza hakunyitwe inore ziteganyana mu nyandiko ya IUCN. Mu ghe ibibazo gikinye, umwobvodyo wa PPA asabo abashokwe gumekura ipererezza ryishyane gukurukana ku kibazo harama no kuja swire y'ibibazo kugira ngo hakorwe ipererezza nyimbate n'imipu y'ikibazo metse akunakwa inengiyabhe uyu bizagendza.

Uburuyo bwo kurweyo mbizane

Mu rwego guhararima ku buru kibazo gishobora kuwuga gikumera mu buryo boboneye kugira ngo birushohe gafasha uhuanga ndetse n'abagemerwakibona bagizewo inguruka

1. **Gukurirana:** Umushingira uzatangaza amakuru yombitshe areba umushinga, inoira zikorehwa mu gutanga bibito ku muntu utaruyize n'ingine runaka. Hasangazwe iyandiko nyinshi zdutandukene kandi zisakezwe ku bagenerwenobwokosha banyanjerwe hakoresheje uburyo burimo imbuba Nkoranyamawo, iyanduko, iUCN ndetse n'umushinga izotangaza zino za imiterere.

2. **Gukurirana:** Hasangazi zibane: Huzobwa gahunda zo gukunzirana inozwe zbantu baganze gutanga abaturage lumva neta ingano n'imiterere byumushinga ndetse n'inoira zifashishwa mu gutanga bibito ku mume hai ingano rukuru umuntu tanyuwe nayo.

3. **Uruhare:** na bagenerwenobwokosha mu gukurirana ESMAP: Guha umushinga abagenerwenobwokosha ndetse n'ibiyono byavughoje inganuka r'umushinga mu gukurirana ESMAP bizifasha mu gutuhayro uburyo bwiza bwo kumenya inoira zifashishwa ndetse no gumkura bibito na mbarwe y'uko bikomera.

4. **Uburyo Gakondo:** bwo Gumkura amakimbirane (Gacaca, Abunzi, etc.) Aho Ibibazo bizingireye ku makimbrane hagati y'ibiyono cyingwe abagenerwenobwokosha (urugero ikbao gushingire ku kunzirana ubuneganzira ku butaka) cyingwe byatsele n'umushinga, hazahwa gukoreho uburyo gakondo busanize bwifashishwa mu guhosa amakimbirane.

5. **Gutanga kirego:** Biremwe gutanga kirego ighe ikibazo cyamunyeshwe abagushinze ariko ntikemgware mumubyo bushingizwe uwatangize.

6. **Agsanduku Kageneve:** Ibiterekere/Ifidzo — Agsanduku kageneve kwakira biterekere ndetse n'ibito ku abaturage, abagenerwenobwokosha ndetse n'abafatanyamikorwa gatanginjwe guhuriwa ahanaterana abantu mugice umushingizwashyiriyemo mu bikorwa.

7. **Uburyo aya mawbiriza mu mushinga uzishyirwa mubikorwa:** Gushyira mu bikorwa aya mawbiriza bireba bwambwe Umukooz iuhinze ibijanye n'ibidzikide mu kigo IUCN, nk'i ngiko gihiyenezwe byumushinga gushyira mu bikorwa no gukuririrana Ibuvo mushinga ku nevega ngo Afurika. Umukooz iitele ikicuro muri IUCN Rwanda akaba kandi ari mu bashinzeze umushinga umuntu ku munsi, nawe arebwa no gushyira

1. Intangiriro

### 1.1 Impamvu ya Gahunda yo Gukurimira Ingakuru zaterwa no kubusa abaturage Ubunenganzira bwo Gukorisha Umutongo Kamere w'ahakorero bikorwa by'umushinga

1. Iyi gahunda yasitsyweho hagamije gutanga umurongo ku itegura n'iishyine mu bikorwa nya gahunda yo gukurima ingakuru zaterwa no kubusa abaturage ubunenganzira bwo gukorisha umutongo kamere w'ahakorero gikorwa bikorwa by'umushinga, bityo bikura byagira ingakuru ku bakoreho ubutaka bitwize no kutabanza gukorisha w'a'kilo binzwe utawane n'imutongo kameru wabo, mu gye cyo gutyaha mu bikorwa umushinga ujumije kukubangura bidikukale mu guteza imbere intavya b'urubasirazwa.

2. Iyi gahunda igamije pakuru, mu buryo bunzwe kandi busize mu muryo, ingakuru ku buzima bw'abaturage bitwese no gukurima gukorera umutongo kamere w'ahakorero bikorwa by'umushinga. Umushinga uziye utike Bikorwa bidikukanye bishobura gisaba ko abaturage babuwe gukorisha umutongo kamere w'a'ho bikorwa bizakerwa kugira ngo ikborwa byo guiana ibyanyije byingiye bibahwe gikorwa nta mbogambo.

3. Umushinga uzatorana bikorwa bhererere mu bitezicandawo ariko uburo bahariye bw'ukulo bizakerwa buzakwara mu gye cyo cy'ubutu mu bikorwa nyabo. Bitu, mu gye cy'itugura ny'umushinga ritshyirenyehe mu bishobura bizakwara ko abaturage bidikukene gukorero n'imungu kameru wabo gikorwa by'umushinga. Bityo gahunda ibiyuru bwe gukurima ingakuru zaterwa no kubusa abaturage babuwe gukorera umutongo kamere w'a'ho bikorwa bizakerwa itegurera ariuko uburo bikorwa byamaze gutanore.

4. Bityo, hakeneve itegura nya gahunda izagema ibiyijane no kubusa abaturage gukorera uwo mutongo kamere n'ikigega bitengenya n'ikigega cyo Kubunganga bidikukwe (IUCN), Umuterakuraga ny'umushinga, ndetse nk'ituko bitengenya na gahunda ay'ubiryo bwe gucuru bidakake y'hururo Mupanzamuhanga nyo Kubunganga bidikukwe (IUCN), ndetse n'itwego ritshyire nyishyine mu bikorwa by'umushinga.

5. Iyi gahunda ikeriengura kandi ikirenanya amateguko n'amabwiriza yikutakizwa, hagaragaza ibigamba kwitabatwaho n'iishyineye gutuhawe Abaturage bazagerazwa n'ingororo zo ku bakemwore ahazkorenwa bikorwa by'umushinga. Iyi gahunda igapazaga oko kubusa abaturage ikoreshwa ny'mutongo kamere w'ahakozorenwa bikorwa bizakerwa, ibiyijane byo


---
**Page 417**
---

gutoranya ibikwora nyirinazikowara, gusengsengura ingarku z'ibikwora by'umushinga ku baturage, imikoramire a'tabanyafubikwira (Bigogano), kugira uruhare mu bikwora by'umushinga, gutanga amakuru, ndetse no nkukema ibikwora by'ubukyaka, kukaguriza ngu inkangura zokoma ku ishinya mu bikwora ny'ibikwora by'umushinga zakumirwa, kuriarabikwira no gutanga raporo, ndetse n'inzego ngo inzego imyiri (izakoreshwa muri ibo bikwora).

5. Iyi gahunda yateguye na IUCN, yemweze na Ministeri l'ibidukukire binyuze mu kigo kiyaumihikyeye cyo kukungabungana Amasazimba (RFA). Ibigo bizishyara mu bikwora uyo mushinga ni ikigo cyo kukungabungana Amasazimba (RFA). ENABE ndetse na IUCN, ibi ngo bikizaka bishize guturge nyogura no gushyira mu bikwora inishinga z'iibikwora bisakala to abaturage babuwa uberangirana two guteshura gumutekano kumuho uro aho ngo bikwora bikoreware.

6. Iyi gahunda izishyara mu bikwora hakumikate amateganya y'ibwa Rwanda ndetse na Gahunda z'imicugure l'ibidukukire y'igikyo cyo kukungabungana ibidukukire yo bigo byo GICN na IUCN. Hachingine ku itamhe nyiha gahunda yo kukungabungana ibidukukire yo IUCN wo ikweta cyane ku ubayabe waziganga inkangura kurundi undo, litore rya gushyara imburaga mu kumbira no ruhinda gufasha ababayeke kurusha abandu n'iryo ritsizikurwa.

7. Iyi gahunda ikubiyemo uburo bwategenyigwe nyumushinga wo kukungabunga ibidukukire mu ritara y'ibarazirazuda ndetse na gahunda izokwanyanaywe byose bigamije gumikura ingarku zagera ku bagenzerubikwira. Iyi gahunda nyaza ikubiyemo muri gahunda z'imicugure y'ibidukukire watengenyige nyiho mushinga.

1.2. Ibirebana n'Umushinga

8. U Rwanda ndetse n'intamya y'burazirizuba by'memhariko buganijwe n'iyo bikurikira:

- Kwanyanga ke'amafaka, impuzure n'inkanguru bitera ingarku z'imhindagukire yi'ibhe ku timera ruumushinga kamerere cyane cyane ku byo ricino ndetse n'abaturage batunzwe cyane no gukoresha umutongo kamerere
- Kwangikira k'ubatuka biterwe no buka buzakorshwa mu buryo bunze, bigitara ingarkura zikomoka ku mhindagukire yi'ibhe.
- Ubakenke cyane cyane ku batuye mu bicye by'icaro, aho ingarkura zabwo zongerera ubwabina n'ingankuru z'imhindagukire yi'ibhe no kwangikira kubatuka biterwe no kukuba uburyo n'ubushobobi butuma ubotaka buzakorshwa neza kugira ngo bubasha gutanga umusuroo ufasha kubona ibyo abaryage bakenyeye mu guteza imbere imberene myiza yabo.

9. Mu rwego neo gukumera ibyo bikwaze bitenwa n'mhindagurukire y'igihye, umushinga ujagimie gushyirano no guteza imbere uburo nuzoro ibwo gufasha abaturage izi'abandi batifanyanibikwira kubasha guhunganu inyo hinduguruka ry'ibihye, bagamije kukuba ubudahangawana rw'ibidukulikwe n'ubutaka by'mumherako mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba kugira ngo butanuro umusaguru kugira ngo umusaruro ry'ubuhinzi wiyongyeje muri aho karere bakizabuka kugahanya ubukene, hongerera ubudahangawana ku mhindagurukire y'ibihye bwebye bogamije kwamba mu birwaho.

10. Uyu mwinga wo kubungubuga ibidukulikwe mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba umugaye gufasha abaturage iyi Ntara guhinduro no kunusa imicurugye ry'ubutaka kugira ngo ubutaka bwinu bwarangirite, butabikwaha kwera nzeza bitwero n'mhindagurukire y'ibihye bubasha koranga guusiranwa no kwitabwaho hagamijwe gufasha abaturage cyane cyone amb'akiro make kubaka ubudahangawana ku ngaruka n'mhindagurukire y'ibihye; aho babasha kubona ibibatanga n'amazi bihajige.

# Ikigamiwe 2: Gufasha ng'okongera agaciro ikibomoka ku buhinzi ndetse no guhanamira ko ibindi binhinga bigira ubutangawawa ku mihindagurikire y'ihibi

## Igikwara 2.1: Gufasha amazirahyamwe n'umatisimwa y'abahini gukora ubuhinzi bubasha guhangana n'imhindagurikire y'ihibi no kubafasha ku bokoma igishoro no kugura mu kusiro maku binozibonehe (Uzakora Igikwara: IUCN)

## Igikwara 2.2: Gufasha guhangana umusoro wa ikibomoka ku buhinzi mu bunyo butangiza ibidukilije (Uzakora Igikwara: IUCN)

## Igikwara 2.3: Gufasha bukoma igishoro no kugura mu kani yifashishwa mu bikorwa by'ubuhinzi butangiza ibidukilije

# Ikigamiwe 3: Gufasha no kongerera ubutangawawa ngego c'ubusobayo haba ku ngwo ne'mighugu n'inzego zegerevine abaturage mu kubungabunga ibidukilije no guhangana iringakura z'imhindagurikire y'ihibi

## Igikwara 3.1: Kiwekama ihamo ny'ubutangirane mu gufatura no gushyira mu bikorwa gahanga ku kongerera ibidukilije (Uzakora Igikwara: IUCN)

## Igikwara 3.2: Kuroza ubwero bwe kubona no amakuru ibitekerezo no gufata ibyemezo mu kubungabunga ibidukilije (Uzakora Igikwara: IUCN)

## Igikwara 3.3: Kuroza ubwero bwe kubona no gukwirekeza uwo butandukirye bari'ingembe zibasha guhangana n'imhindagurikire y'ihibi (Uzakora Igikwara: IITA)

## Igikwara 3.4: Gukyana no gusangira amakuru y'uburo bukwije kandi bunozze mu kubungabunga ibidukilije

12. Uyu musinga ubanda ku mara y'ibirurazuba (ipishunyane) 3 arko gaac mu kwanda gukana n'umwanga y'uburo bwe mu gushyira mu bikorwa na ritera igize ni olutere turimide antwo: Bugesera, Rwerangana, Ngoma, Kirhe, Nyamora, Gisabo na Nyanzate kufa ifite ubuso base km² 9.813 (N'ukuvuga 20% by'ubuso bweze mighugu). Akazé gaharizanga cyane n'imbariho, ibihanga, ndetse ni'mbara bigihu bafu ha misici ndetese ni'mbara.

Pariki y'akagera irerenyere mu nkengero ziyo mara y'ibirurazuba, ikaba ihanu imbiyi mighugu cyo Tanzania. Intara y'ibirurazuba ni intara uvueza cyane mu Rwanda aho ifite abaturage barabirwira miri 305,814 mi ku uwanga bangana 24% by'abaturage base by'ihuguru nabo batanirwaga miri 12,665,116 mu mukaka wa 2020.

13. N'ikuko byagaragajwe haruguru, umushinga uzistanya ibikorwa, ugaragaze uko bizashyira mu bikora ndetse usengezane inguruka zishobora gutera no kubusa abaturage ubunangiranga bwo gukoresha umutungo kamere akahakorera ibikorwa by'umulungu.

Ibi bizakozana mu gwe umushinga ubwabo watanyige gusyihura mu bikora mu gushyira mu bikora gahunda yo usyizirabuka biddukidye mu ritara y'uburaisazuba ndetse ndetse n'igice ibikorwa bizaba bymazwe gukoresa. Kubw'ijyo mpamvu, mu ghe cyo gutegura umushinga, nitibiramenyekana ibikorwa bibohora gusidla ko abaturage babuwa gukoresha umutungo kamere waho bizakorewe, umubare wa'abishobora kugwaho inguruka ndetse n'dubumere bw'inguraka zishobora kubaho. Bityo, ibikorwa binni bigaragaze ko bizasaba ko abaturage ko babuwa gukoresha umutungo kamere waho bizakorewe nibyo bibohora kugaragazwe ubu.

14. Ibikorwa bizangiriyange we gusyibiranya ibidukidye mu twara tw'intwira y'uburaisazuba ndetse amahayambya ya leta, ahanru hakomwe, ndetse dukunda kwangarwa n'isuru, inkorero i byibaga n'imigezo, inkengero z'inimhanda ndetse no bu buhumero bwa za parki ya Aklage. Haa hese, bibohora kuba kuga ngomhereko ko abaturage basanwe bakoresha umutungo kamere waho babuwa kuwakoresha, cyangwe se amabazirwa yarayanzwe akurikiza agembe inkorimeshange y'umutungo kame wa utero duze akaba yakaza kuruhanga ko gura ngi ibimera n'idukidye biko muri udwo byongere byigane ndetse n'ingemwe z'ibiti byatwete zibshe gyfata no gukura neza.

15. Gusa birishoboka ko hamwe mu hakazorwa ibi bikora abaturage bwa bakoresha gukoresha umutungo kamere waho cyenge abakamene kugira ngo babashe babase kubuko. N'ikuko byagaragajwe haruguru, 37% by'abaturage b'intwira y'uburaisazuba bawa mu bikora ndetse 15% by'abaturage b'iyi ritara mwa bu bulukene bubujije.

Bityo mumirikana nika ko abaturage bakenye umutongo kumare harimo ibikoroma ku mashyamba kugirango babaze kukifukishya mu mibereho yabo.

Abaturage bashobora kubwiza gukoresha umutongo kumare usa muti ibyo bice mu gihye kibirwa hatagi y'impaka 2 ni n'yimuka 3 ku biti 'ibimerera by'umutongo, hatagi y'imuka 5-3 ku biti 'byimbuto ndetse n'inyamika igera kuri 20 ku biti bibazowamo imabho. Bityo, hashobora kuba inguruka zineremeye ku baturage cyane cyane ab'umikino muke kusa unganga baba bafite ubushoboci bwe bwo kubwaha ibikoroma ibisibwa n'imipinduka nadetse bakabaka ndetse 'n'ubushoboci bwe kubona icye basimvuna ibyo bari bazawer bakoresha ighe byaba bitakoloneka.

16. Zimeze mu ngaruka zishobora lugera ku baturage bitewe no kubura ubunegaranya bwo gukoresha gukoresha umutongo kumare wabo ibikorwa bizokorenera, harimo kusira irike zo gucana, kubura imabho, kubura amayibye n'micanga byo kubaka, kubura imiti ngakondo, imbuto, imigano, ubutu, ibhingwa bitandukanye, bikorwa byo guhugyi, kuragira n'ibindi. Ibi byose usanga bizabatwaza mu mirimo ny mu rugo, kugirishwe mu masiko ndetse no gukoreshera mu mihango tianukuhye harimo ubutu, gushingira, imihango y'amadini n'ibindi.

17. Imbonerahamwe ya 3 igaragara inguruka kubaho ziterwe no kuba abaturage bibuswa gukoresha umutongo kumare a shakorera bikorwa by'umutongo ku cyane cyane ku bikorwa bitanganyize ku ntugo ya mbere y'unyamushiga.

Nta garuka zitecwe ku bikorwa by'intego ye 2 n'yitsa gatatu y'unyamushiga bitewe n'ubwoko bw'ibikorwa bizokorenera. Bityo kuko bidabisa ibikorwa byaharire kumareno kuri ubwo butaka, hakuliyemo bikorwa bitafisha gutuma ikorwa bishyekwe bibasha lukiga umusoro ndetse hakuhako n'imipinduka ku biribokorenera inye uzbutaka.

Imbonerahamwe ya 3: Inguruka zishobora kubaho bitewe no kubaza abaturage gukoresha umutongo kumare a shakorera bikorwa by'unyamushiga ku ntugo ya mbere y'unyamushiga. (Kubungabunga ubutaka aho ibhingwa bishaba guhangana n'inguruka z'yiragirika ry'ibidukizwe mu Ntara y'ibirusarazuba

Ikibora by'umushinga ntugo birimo ikibuba kuba abaturage bakwinburusa imtungo yabo, Ikibora by'umushinga kandi nitibilikumbwe ibyasaya mukima, butewe no gatukaza uburenganzira bwo gukorera umutungo kamere w'ahfo ikiborwa bikorere, harimo abaturage bagize batura nta byingambwa beti bakakura amaze mu bice bibujwe hadukarikye icyo ubutaka bwagweneye.

20. Iyi nyandiko yita guza kwo mupamvu ntugo habana hubu kubuka gakoreka umutungo kamere ku hasakererwa ikibora ndetse n'inguruka byetse bitunzwe ku bikorwa by'umushinga. Aya mabwiriza akusyemvo zateganya n'umushinga ndetse no guthiya imbaraga mu iyabuhiriwa y'amalwerica yari asanwe arko akaba abutakarikwe uku bikweye mbere kwo uyo muphinga utangira.

21. Iyi gahunda kandi nitireba inguruka zagera ku baturage iziteneza no kukubwa gukorera umutungo kamere w'ahfo ikiborwa bozakerewa cyane ku bijanyen n'icugwana rya pariki y'alagakera, ndetse n'amalwerica asanwe ashiyirwa kandi akusyabiriwa ny'inzego zidateganyizwe muri uyu muphinga.

3. Amatageko azubuhiriwa mu gikumva lioreshe ry'umutungo kamere w'ahazakererewa ikibora by'umushinga

22. Iyi gahunda izishyirwe mu bikorwa hagendewe ku matageko iyabuhiriwa mu Rwanda ndetse na gahunda yo kubungabunga ibotukizwe y'ikigaze cyo kubungabunga idzikidzwe (IGCD), ndetse na gahunda yo kutungabungana ibotukizwe ya IUCN. Iyi gice cy'iti nyandiko kiganagiza amatageko azakurikize mu gihe abaturage bazaba babujwe gukorera umutungo kamere cyane cyane lioreshe ry'ubutaka a'ahazakererwa ikiborwa by'umushinga. Hagendewe ku ihame nayo IUCN ry'uko abagweto inguruka kurusha abandu arivo bitabako ku ibikorso, iti hame niyoro rizubuhiriwa mu gihe abaturage bazaba babujwe uburenganzira ku ikoresha ry'umutungo kamere igihe cy'shiyirwa mu bikorwa by'umushinga.

3.1. Amategeko y'u Rwanda azagenderwaho

23. Hagaridwe kuri politiki yakoreheza ry'ubutaka mu Rwanda ya 2004, ndetse n’Intego N/48/2013 rwo kuwa 16/05/2013 rukorwa Intego ndetse No.08/2005 ryo kuwa 14/7/2005, iIghugu kini kukuhunda amategeko ayainge imikorehereheze y’ubutaka aho ubutaka butariki umutungo gakondo w’umuntu gufa ahubwo Leta ifite ubunyenganoza ku micangire yebwo.

24. Amategeko i micangiro z’ubutaka yaweheba utabuka bintwe l’agece runika ndotse ndetse ni mnyingi y’ubuto, akendi yibyo achiyikwe ku ruruhakereke ru’mumungo mu bagasi umutongo aho abantu baturukuruhye bahaga ubutaka abakutsobwa. Ndiye ndetse n’Intego N/48/2013, iIghugu kini kukuhunda amategeko uhu, bagahakurenya ubutaka ibwehe umuntu bantu gatangira. Muri mate, amategeko i micangiro gakondo y’ubutaka bwagenderwa ku micangire y’ubutaka binzwe mu burwo butatu: (1) Kubwa utabuka bwangewa abana cyane ibyimbye; (2) Ubutaka bwangatwa n’umutekere (3) ndetse no kuba ubutaba bidafite nyirwabye bwangatwa. Bituho binumukalika ko ihererakenehe ry’ubutaka byagira nyenema ku utabuka bwangewa n’umuntu ku giti cye cyingawa itsinda iy’abantu bendo. Mu gitye cikukororo ndetse na nyuma yahoo, imicangire y’ubutaka yagize ihinduka butakira ubutaka bew’muntu lu giti cye cyingawa se utabuka bwe Leta. Gusa ibi byakomeje gutera kuvguzurugana ya amategeko ayainge koreheza ry’ubuto.

25. Hagaridwe ku buru n’dikobuka ndetse n’amaskambire yonkuye luganda avuko, u Rwanda rwashyizho gahunda z’imicangiro y’ubutaka ubwenge ku kuba umuntu ugira abatuka bakurikeye amategeko yanditse cyange wa ubutaka bintwe ahuwa leta. Hagaridwe kuri politiki y’ubutaka mu Rwanda ya 2004, ndetse nyo 2005 (2011) ndetse na gahunda z’imicangiro y’ubutaka, bahagya hubuhanda imiterere y’ubutaka bwe kuba ubuhinzi gakondo guwa bwo kwizha mu biribwa, buhuhinda ubuhinzi tw’amwinga buganije. Itekoze ry’ubutaka ritengaya ko ny’ubutaka abantuho kandi akabukorusa kukumbi cyange se hakabaho gukodesehe utabuka mu gikirihe kupira ngo ubukorosha agire umutakono mu kubukorosha ndetse abantu no kubukorosha neza.

26. Ubutaka bwe Leta bwaginyambizemo bibi: (1) Utabuka bwe leta bari ahuruto y’umuntu rwange ruzange nk’mikangiridose n’ikirango zayo, amasimbiya kumbira, pariki g’iligikyo. Bisanga bikinyo, imihinda mikuru ndetse ni mnyinga zabo, n’ahandi. Hori kandi (2) utabuka bwe Leta butafwa nk’mumungo twahe harimbo ubutabe adifite bo twabintshaba, butuwe bwafanirire mu Leta, utabaka bwaguzwe, impano, utabaka bwemwemo imitungo ku nyungu rwange, bisanga


---
**Page 431**
---

bidakomye ndetse n'amashyamba ya leta. Ku butaka bukomye ndetse za pariki z'igihugu. Politiyi y'ubutaka yo 2004 iteganya ubunyo n'amategikoto yahirwe, harimo no gushiminkira abaturuye ubwo butaka kupira uruhure mu kubungabungwa hayishinga amatsinda l'abaturuye agara unuhare mu kubungabunga ubwo butaka. Bintu, itegikyo No 3/2010 of 24/09/2010 nihyaro pariki y'Akagera, imbago zayo ni'igice cy'ubuhumekerero bweho ndetse n'agace gakorawemo ikiboka lyi'tserambe nshuroka gikurikwiza.

27. Muri ago mateguko yose agema ubutaka, rita ngingo iha abaturuye ubunganirangabo gukuresho ubutaka bwa Leta ndetse n'umugumo kumero uburu n'amashyamba ya leta yangiritso, ibice bikome, cyinga ne ahanta hukuridze kwabasina ni'suri nk'ikombe lyi'nzicu, amashyamba aki ru ikengerero mu 'nhamakira ndetse n'agace utu mu buhumekero bwa pariki y'Akagera. Aha akaba an iko bikoraho by'umugumo bigamye gusana.

Ikboka bitemwe ne Leta kandi ngo birigwemo r'ubuyobozi nt'rugyo byemwe kandi birabujyize, nk'uko beteganyije mu ngingo u 26/0 tegiko nru 2013 ritungi cugencana imi'nikorosherere y'amashyamba mu Rwanda. Imikoroshereze wemenye y'uubutaka ishobora kwemera ni'ingero zemewe n'amategikoto cyingwa bigakoreza hashingize ku kibuka ruzana cyuhirwe cyagarapaje.

Nkurugero, itegiko nru 2013 ritungi amashyamba ritenganya ko halabu guberi ibiti binangwe ni'mujya mu butaka bwanigereve ubushinzi n'ubwanzo ruzho. Ingingo ya 37 teganya ko uhyango ruzi leta rokoroka guhutira umuntu ku gitu mu kuribaya umusororo, naho ingingo ya 40 miringyo ya 45 miringyo tanga ry'ubunganirage bwe gusanga amashyamba la Leta cyingwa bigahitse y'izinto agamwiza abantu ku ruzi ko cyigo. Ritsyi byengera, amakoperative, imvanyo itani ya Leta ndetse n'abaturuye mu bazazeno bagirira.

Umutwe kwa VII ugurika ku bijanye no gutanga uruhuruka ku bikoraho bwe kukyusa umusororo amashyamba harimo gakumya ndetse no gukursa ikiboka ku mashesha. Mbu, ngo ngingo ya 23 bitenginya ko gusarura amashyamba ndetse no gukumsa i tuyobokohoko bidubuka guhagarikwa by'apetyagene hagamwe kio ayo muzimba abunganirage cyinga ne yongera kwibwira.

28. Bintu, gukusanga amashyamba y'ibiti ndetse n'ibiti byemwe hagamijwe kukabina ndetse no gusarura ibiti bibazawamo ubwane wemewe ni'mujya ko gukumira mu bwubati binzwe l'abaturuye ndetse rinziyi nyubuko, imihye ku gurukorwa cyinga ne iiteni bikomoka ku mashesha bidobora kwemera ni'ingero z'ubuyobozi, oyane cyane bitututise ku mpamvu zatangana n'ubuyobozi bw'inzego iz'ibanzwe.

**Page 432**

29. Gusa, ingingo zirebana no kuba huba kwishyurwa kubera nyirumutongo yaka yabujjwe uburengancira bwo gukoresha weyo mutungo kamere ntago bitenganywe mu matekengo by'umwikamba mu ghi ubutaka bukworeka mu buryo bunyaruranye amatekego.

30. Itegeko N° 32/2015 nno kuwa 11/06/2015 nnerweye kikwema abantu ku mpmamu z'inyungu rusange, rigema uko ikwinurwa bikorwa nanyo ntayo ritengana ku binyanye no kubuzwa uburengancira bwo gukoresha umutongo kamere igihe hari bikorwa by'umshinganya bigeye kukahoreka. Bityo, itegeko nyerweye kwamba abantu ku mpmamu z'inyungu rusange ntiritabwaho mu binyanye ni bikorwa by'uyu mutshinga.

### 3.2. Amahame Ngenderwaho ya IUCN n'ikigega cyo kubungabunga ibidukilike GCF

1. Ambawiriza agenga ibijyanye no kuba abaturage babura uburengancira ku ikoreshe ry'umutungo kamere ani akahorekana bikorwa by'umshinga akubuye muri gahunda y'ikigega cyo kubungabunga ibidukilike (GCF) n'itenganywe muri gahunda yo kubungabunga ibidukilike ya IUCN. Ikigege cyo kubungabunga ibidukilike (GCF) cyashyihene uburu lyi gahunda iyishwa mu bikorwa bashinganye ku bitenganywe n'ikigega mpumalamanha cy'imari (IFC). Ambawiriza yakoreshe mu guhe gitso, ni ibijyanye no kuba abaturage babura uburengancira bwo gukoresha umutongo kamere mu gihye cy'ikorwa by'umshinga bitenganywe ngamo yina 5 (irebana inikoreshe nyi) ndabatse ndetse no kuba nyarubwera zizakumenwe (nyingyo sga 7). IUCN nayo yatengaye muri gahunda yano yo kubungabunga ibidukilike.

2. Iki gice nkiguruka cyane ku byinenge n'abamarwe yakaba yabo aya GCF ntetse na IUCN yo kubuzsa abaturage uburengancira bwo gukoresha umutongo kamere, kuko uwashingana udateganya gufasha no gukoresha umutungo w'abaturage ndetse no ku bakumbaka. Ibikwirwe mu ngingo bitenganywe n'amawbiriza na GCF ntetse na IUCN birahye, ndetse bizanasobanurwa rimwe. Ingingo z'ingiho bitandukamwe nyino zaizagaragara nk'ako bikwirwe.

3. Aya mabwiriza y'ibigo uko ari biberi atenganye ibijyanye no ikwinurwa ku batangese ndetse ni ibijyanye no gutakaza uburengancira bwo gukoresha umutongo kamere bitumwa bakura abo ha bakura libatungana bitewe e bikorwa by'umshinga ndetse no kubuzsa abaturage uburengancira bwo gukoresha umutongo kamere uru akahorekana ikibonwa.


---
**Page 433**
---

34. Aha mbawiriza ateganya uko izi ngaruka zikowunika hashingeye ku buremene bwafo, aho bikorwa by'umutanga bizaharamira mu buryo bushoboka bwabo ko bikorwa bystuma habaho kimukwa kw'abaturage hazahakizimba uburopy twose umutungiro wazhyirwa mu bikorwa hatabyahe zingokwiza kukuruza baturage.

Aho bidoshoboka, ingaruka zikomoka ku kuba abaturage bubabera ubunyenganzira bwo gukoroka umutungiro kamere zigomba gusengeuranga ndetse zikamugirwa hatagwe ngoranya y'ibyo umutumage yahayimye; ahawba igiciro kinyaga n'bwo yatakye hagamije gutabera abaturage kukira imberho myiza.

Igihye habaye ko atubaturage bimurese, uwemwe ogutuza guhawa ina... (ngaruka no gutura ubunyenganzira ku butungo kamere waho aho bikorwa by'umutanga bikorwora bigomba gutiweka, hatagwe ngoranya mu buryo buntse, tuza inama, kandu abagebwo igirangana ko zikubura ubunyenganzira ku mutungo wabo bakagira uruhare ndarange mu byino ikorwa n'ibigamiro byose. IUCN isaba ko uwugwezho ingaruka no kubura ubunyenganzira ku mutungo kamere asobanirwana kandi akemera ku mugagararo ibyo zakareremo mu mumusha.)

35. Igikiga mpuzamahanga cy'imiari (IFC) mu mahame yacyo ku mikorene, ihamwe rya 5 rigaragaza ko byitwabawaho ari bici bikorwa: (1) kubura ubunyenganzira bwo gukoroka ubutuza n'umutungiro kamere ku bataturage cyingwaga amatandiko aitali; (2) kubura ubunyenganzira bwo gukoroka umutungiro kamere uhuherero ni ubutungo, umutungiro kamere w'amasi, intabuka, bikorwa ku misahymweba, imiti gakondo, kubura ubunyenganzira bwo gukorika bwo byigikho, kuragura, n'ibendi...

36. Mu gihe igikiga mpuzamahanga cy'imiari (IFC) mu mahame yacyo ku mikorene, ihamwe rya 5 rigaragaza aho gukurima abaturage gukoroka umutungiro kamere byakoresheko aho abaturage bari basangiyemwe ubunyenganzira gakondo bwo gukoruka umutungiro kamere, ndetse n'aho baro bafite umutungiro bahuruye boso. Ilyi ngingo igaragaza kandi ko abakunda gutalitsa ubunyenganzira bwo gukoroka umutungiro kamere akeshu bari badafite ubunyenganzira ku mikoresheko y'ubutaka mu buryo bweemwe n'amategiko. Byito u ngiryo shiyura mu byiciro abantu badafite ubunyenganzira bwemwe n'amateguko ko butaka bwabo cyingwaga ubwo bakoroka.

37. Amabwiriza igiho IUCN, agaragaza ibigomba bikuhawirwa igihye habaye ko kubusa abaturage kukira ubunyenganzira ku mutungo kamere cyingwaga se kubusiza aho bari basanwe bakoroka no guhindurirwa ubunyenganzira bari basanwe bafite ku mikoresheko y'ubutaka bwabo, ariko

38. Ingingizendawo muri rutsange ku birebana no kuba abaturage bibuzwa ubunengirona bwo gukurosa umutungo kame wabo ikibikorwa nyimushinga ndiyo ni ibikurwana:

- Gushyirayi uburye bwe Kubuhirwa amabatanga hagendawo ku kubanza gusengura inguka z'ikiborwa ku batrage (Amabatiza y'igahiro cy'imani IFU) ibiziga cyo Kubungabunga ibidukulira ndetse na guhunda yo kubungabunga bidukulira ya uICU;
- Gusharana ko abaturage bibuzi uruhare ku bikurawenye harimo kubagoreza amaluro vose mu burwe bukweje, kugirana ibingura ndeto ndetse na kubanza urudzwa no kuba bagazanga ibitandaga ndeta hala mba y'igahiro cy'inigwe. Ighiyane, ihirwya mu bikorwa ndetse ni'tighe cyo gusengura ishyirwa mu bikorwa nayo guhafa abajibuyeve gukurosa umutungo kame raro ikiborwa nyimushinga bikorwe;
- Gukora ibarwa ni'isenegura kupira ngo hatapwe amaluro y'ibantu, gusengura inguka ziterwena no kuba abaturage bazisuzwe gukurosa umutungo kame wabo ikiborwa bizakorenwa ndetse na kugaragaza ibikwezi twitabhidzo mu bikorwa bigamije gukurima ingaruka byobagirhi;
- Kweta by'umeharkito ku bibazo n'ingaruka ku byiciro by'abaturage bafite amikoro make harimo ni'abafite ibizazo bizishyige ku kuba abagwehove ingaruka n'ikiborwa babi ari Abagabo cyingana Abagore;

- Gutegura gahunda z'ikisorwa bwo gukurima ngaruka ziterwena no kuba abaturage bibuzwa ubunengirona bwo gukurosa umutungo kame uru akazakorenwa ibyimushinga, gahunda zigiragaza atabatwe kwetabhidzo, gusengura izvo ku tabafashya kwitseza imbere ndetse na gutegura gahunda n'ingengo y'imana yo ku bafashya kumere gukorema ubuzima busarwene;
- Kugaragaza uruhare ni'mushinga mu gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda zo guhafa abanwowe ubunengirona bwo gukurosa umutungo kame uri akhorera ikiborwa nyimushinga;

- Gutegura gahunda yo guhanga n'ingaruka ziterwena no kuba haru abaturage bibajibuye ubunengirona bwo gukurosa umutungo wabo, aru nabayo bizishangirwa mu gutegura uko

**22**

* Gutanga ingurane hashinwe ku ngano y'igaciro cy'ibyanginitshe, hashinwe ku giciro cyabaye ku isoko longerero ikiguzi cy'ikizoborerishwe mu gice cyo kumusyikiriza ibyo yagwenene, ndetse n'iikiguzi cy'ingungu y'ibintu ndetse na servisi kukwanga ku byangitshe;
* Gutanga ingurane ku butaka ku baturage bakwura mu mutungo wabo hashinwe ku buzima baba babayemo;
* Kugaragaza ingamba zo gunikama inguruka mbere y'uko abaturage bakwura mu byabonzo;
* Kugaragaza icyo umushinga uzamirira abagenyerawokidzina ba galunda zo gunikama inguruka ku baturage;
* Kugaragazica abagenyerawokidzina ndetse no kweneza galunda z'iizikoreroze abaturage mu kubardina inguruka zimokoma ku kubura ubungenazira two gukorero umutungo kamerere w'ako ibikwora byumushinga bizokerawo n'iibyo bitengana n'ikigega cyo kukugabungwa ibudukidze (GUC) ndetse na (UGCN).

39. Mu guye halabye gutazika ubungenangira ku mutungo, hagomba kubaho kugaragaza bikiweke kwitabwalo ndetse n'ibigeneve abazingwe inguruka ni ibyo bikwora hagamijive kukafasha longera kugira imberhe miya yahimo harino:
* Gutanga ingurane hashinwe ku giciro cy'ingangiritshe haka ba kutuba cyangwa se undi mutungo w'abantu basembe bafiitbye ubungenazira bukukiriza amategoko;
* Kutanga ingurane hashinwe ku gaciro cy'ibyanginitshe ku wundu mutungo utara ubutaka;

43. Ilesengura rigiragaza ko hari icyuho mu matejego rusange agenderawaho mu biliyanje no kubuzza abaturage uborenganira ku ikorere ny'ubutaka n'umutongo kamere ndetse ni ibityuro bwo gumkima ingirakwa zabu ko mberhero y'abaturage. Ilyega cyo Kubungabunga bidukikaze GCF (FCC) cyozhetye amatewamira yo gumkima ingaruka ku mberhero y'abaturage bazogweho ingiraka: bikorwa byo kubuzza uborenganira, abuhwo bakinjyaza miri gahunda ni bikorwa byo kugena uko byakosana, gumkima ingaruka ndetse no kubungabunga umutongo kamere mu bikorwa byo umuhanga.

Nduwo amateguko yu Rwanda ateganya biliyanje no gukorasa abaturage mu bikorwa byo kubungabungana umutongo kamere, nta buryo buhuri bufatika bujanywe no gufasha abaturage babajyewe gumkora uutomango kamere wabo uherrereye aho bikorwa byo umuhanga y'ugiragano babashe kugira imberhero myiza, by'umuhawiko abafite amikoro make.

Bityo, Gahunda yo gumkima ingaruka zatema no kubuzza abaturage uborenganira bwo bikorweha umutongo kamere wa'ahakorera bikorwa muri vyu mushinga wo kubungabunga bidukikaze mu ritara y'ubazarazozwe izishywe mu bikorwe hawishige ku bitenganya n'amaterwamira y'ilyega cyo kubungabunga bidukikaze (GCF) ndetse na gahunda ya IUCN.

44. Isinegura nyakozwe ngaragaza kandi ko hani intinge nke ku bijanye no kuba hari abaturage batandikilika ubutaka bwebo buguzinure mu buryo twayo gakindo. Ikindi cyagagarayi ne uko abaturage bafite amakore make, abaturage bafate mu bunike ndetse n'abahudo mu bakune bukajuye akhenyi bakomeza gukorusha mu buryo butemene umutongo kameru uri ku butaka bwe Leta bijenye no kupanga ubudzobho buke wa'miberehero.

Umutongo kameru ndetse n'ubutuka bakomwabwa mu buhino mu bici boke bikonowambo ikorwana by'umushinga (amashyamba ya Leta, amashyamba y'umutongo, inkome z'iibaya ngimwezi), ikerengero l'inimhanda ndetse n'ibiyana by'abazimbwekero mu pariki j. kenshi usanga birimo umutongo kamere wifishawisa a-baturage, uho usangu uwo mutungo wifishawisa mu kubona ibitungwa mu bwima bwa buni muri ndetse no kubona aka buraka amafurara bicije mu kugushira ibiva muri uwo umutongo kameru.

45. Umushinga ubatenda cipana ko ngaruka cyane ku bataturage bakimakore make bazinwera bitwwe no kwambirwa ubumnganzora ku ikorokwe ny'umutongo kamere w'ahazikorenwa ikorwana by'umushinga, cyane abani mumu y'unumongo w'ubukene, abatagira ubutaka, absishese akanghure, abagone n'abana, absaisigwe inyuma n'amaketa, ndetse n'ibindi byisico ku abaturage usanga akhenyi bishobora kugira ubudzobho bucyie bwe gukurikiza isyo amatekengo y'igihugu agena ku ikorokwe ny'ubutaka mu buryo butwirayi.

Aho bizagaragara ko abatange bataturage umutongo kamere bari basowe bewakorenya mu burypo bunyurayise n'amatekengo nabo bazitabwembo mu byisico by'abazimbweka bakafosshwa hakuriykwe ngingiro zinategena n'ikigega ny'iru KCF (USF) aho gatizengana ko abaturage bazinwene bakoresha uwo mutungo kamere mu buryo butemene n'amatekengo bashobora guhulwa ingurane ihwanye no bwe batakize aritio itani y'ubutaka.

### Umushinga ndetse n'ibikorwa byawo uzagerazwe gukumira, bukaganya ibukana ndetse no guhangana n'ingakura zohutula gumaya habaho gutakaza umutongo cyangwa kinekwa nk'uko biteganywa mu mahame ikyige ko kukungabunga ibudikulize GCF ndetse na IUCN.

**Gukorana n'Abafatanyikwibora**

- **Bikorwa byose aho bikazenerwe ka guhunda yo kubusa abaturage gukumira umutongo kamere w'ahakozirekena ibikorwa by'umushinga ndetse n'ibikorwa aho bikazenerwe ko abafatanyikwibora bazabigaramo uruhare bizishinya muri gahunda yimvamirane n'abafanyikwibora.**

- **Abaturage bakuzera mu byose n'isihyira mu bikorwa ny'mushinga bazageneriza bamenyinwe ibijanyi ne kuba bakumira ku mikaserenye iyumutongo kamere ighe cy'ohyana mu bikorwa ny'mushinga ndetse na gahunda yo guhangana n'ingakura zokoma ku kubuswa ubengaranya nedete bazabatsehuba r'unwayama no kgula uruhare mu gutegura ibikorwa aho abagoweza inguruka bazafuthwa binyuze mu bunyo bwosorhye, bwomilika kandi butanyiranye n'imberi bane barasana babayemwe. Ingoma sese zimukwamahlo mbere y'uko izihyina mu bikorwa.**

- **Gahunda yo gukumira abaturage ku buengaranya bwu gokuresha umutongo kamere w'ahakorawa ibikorwa by'umushinga, zaba gahunda z'agatanyigwe ndetse n'izemenezi zigazangirera abagenegawebikora ngura bissosume kandi bazatengero ibitsekere. Gahunda nzimara kwemzese kandi nazo zitsikazinyika abagenewabikorwa. Amakuru yose ku bikorwa by'abafatanyikwibora azashyina hemwe uku bikiwe:**

- **Mu ghe cy'tegeneza ny'mushinga, Hazishyareho gahunda yo gumkeba ibiduka bazabigaramo ka bufutane n'abafatanyikwibora bossi, nedete iyi gahunda igaragirize ahagezwe inguruka no kubusa ubengaranya ku ikorreshwa ny'umutongo kamere w'ahakorawa ibikorwa by'umushinga bese. lya gahunda kandi izaharirana ko ibibazo byagaragare bikorwema mu mucu kandi byuthye.**

**Abazagenhwo n'ingakura z'umushinga**

- **Ingo ahabifite amakoro make ndetse n'ingakura zohutula nazo kubera gutakaza ubengaranya bwu gokuresha umutongo kamere zigazangirawa mu barura rikowara kuri buri gikorwa cyose cy'umushinga, ibitsekere by'abagowe inguruka bossi bizitshalehabo ha mu bigamiro ndetse no mu gutegura ibikorwa byo kabufasha gutiza imberele imbwe yabo ku kubairinda ibibazo no gukaganya ubukana bw'ingakura byabagiraho.**


---
**Page 440**
---

**Ngesungura Inguruka zo kubuzu abaturage Uburanganzira bwo Gukoresha Umutungo Kamere wa'ahakorewa Ikibwya by'umushinga**

- **Hazikorera Inzeyimbi yinimbita ku nguruka gahunda yo gukoma imitungo l’abaturage izigira ku buzima bwabo, hazizabara umutungo wabo wangintsehe, hakorewe inesengura ry'ubunyo bari balabyehe, ndetse hasensegurwe n’agaciro k’imitungo yangiritswe ndetse n’inyingi yayo.**

- **Hashingikwe ku ngesungura ny’inguruka zizotserwa ku kubuzu abaturage gukoresha umutungo kamere ku iyiwhya mu bikorwa ry’igikwana runeka, isetengura ku nguruka ku mibenerho l’abaturage izitsishwehu mu guhatamo ingingo zirhye zizokorehwa mu kugaragaza ibizagerenderwo ndetse n’rubunyo abagwemo inguruka ny’iikura ngahanda bazashyiza.**

**Ibizagerenderwo mu guhitamo abatatabweho**

- **Abantu boso bazebogabo n’inguruka za gahunda yo kubuzu abaturage gukoresha umutungo kamere wa'ahakorewa Ikibwya harimo a'badafite uburenganza ku butaka, bakorosha ubutaka bukimire ndetse n’umutingo kamere ureherye aho hantu mbye z’itariki ntarengana yashizweho irapagaza igye ubufasha bumanze, bore bazabala bari mu bazafasha guhananga n’inguruka, aho bazahawwa ingurume no guwimana ibanyigirwe nkuko buteganyiwehaye kutu byo ngurumika zabyehe zaba zhyoro inyungu cy’umutumo muto, zaba ri nkeya cyangwe nyimbi. Abaturage badafite uburenganza ipu kutaka nabo bazitabwaho mu pikorwa gu ku nguruka.**

- **Hatzinganzwa itariki ntarenye a igye ubufasha bugambuga mumkani kandi igatangowe mu gihe cyo gutangura inesengura ny’ikuru garka kunu biki gukorwa mu nwega no rwinda ko hari abalabyetseza bakizanga bibukidutu mnyi cya gihe bemwerere nkuhatra.**

**Ibyo umushinga uzungura abagwemo inguruka ny’ikibwora by’umwo**

- **Gutanga inguruke ku bokoro ibinyangwe igye abaturage bakubanza uburenganzira ku mutungo wabo bizabara hashingirwe ko gazosu umutungo wangintse hari utihe, haba bahayeho ulimwamugore bunyose kuko bokoro umutungwe yakoretse gukoresha umutungo ariko ku mabwizira runaka, cyingwe se bagabahese uburenganzira bwo gukoresha undi mutungo kamere nayo ushobora kukafisha. Kuhatra ny’iitongo mutungo kameru ulwanye ry’iito umutungwe yakoreharya ubatanga kukobusa, hubashwa gutangura ibayishya wa mutso kukubasa kuboko harimo guhaba akati, amahugurwa, gufushwa kukobana inguyino, cyingwe se agahitwa amafaranga kugarango abasha gukomeza kukabho nkuko yarlo mbere.**

* Ighe umuturage atakaje ubutaka cyangwa se inyubako, ibi bizimbuzima n'ibikoresho bihwanije agaciro cyangwa karenzho cyangwa se ahatwe amafaranga bihwanije agaciro yabazwe hanyingirwe ku gicoro giwikwe kiri ko ikiso hoyongerheyo amafaranga yakoresheje kugarango ayo mafaranga amaguruje, inyungu kiruho, igikuyi cy'byangirise ndetse n'andi malaramaga yose ahobora kuba yokareheye kandi ubatwe ugacra okwabo. Ku ngurane y'ubutaka, cyangwa se amazu, ikiguzi cipese kohyehwa ry'unumushinga, izu ntago szatataka agaciro bitwese n'miyaka abantu. Abantu bafuye mu burije bunyemo n'amutatego bazabaze butifwa ubungenciranga ku bikubasa byose guhu bafugira abigwejulo n'ingaruka utabatimweje igicoro kye kuba atakaje atabatimwe.

* Abaturage binmwe bazahabaza ubungenciranga ku butaka, inzu zikwije, ubufasha bwa'inzego ndetse no kukubasa kgura ku bikowara remese.

* Ku butarage bazaba binmetse bitwese n'ibikorwa by'unumushinga, bazahabaza ubufasha bwose n'inkingu ku bikorwa by'unumushinga. Gusunyiraba ibigikobwe banyangirise ndetse no gukorera neza ubutaka muri bunyi gikone cyoje cy'unumushinga binmwe mu bitangemije nyu mu gumikura ingaruka ziterwa no kunidwa ubungenciranga ku mutongo, bintyo ibi bizishyira muri gahunda ry'unumugiranye y'ibikorwa byakozwe.

* Utufaha bwose bunyenga gutwanya mbere y'uko gahunda zo kukubasa ubungenciraga abaturage ku mutongo ziyishyira mu bikowara.


**Ibirikarankibwoka l'Igiterura**

* Ubuyo bunifuye je ny'ihwekimwakorwa nayo gahunda y'ibikorwa yo gumikura obaturage mu mitungo yabo mu gice cy'ihyishyira mu bikorwa ry'unumushinga kuri bungi gikone by'unumushinga hamwe n'ingaruka ku ngando zabyo ku mbenzore a'ubaturage banwuye mu byabo lubera ibikorwa by'unumushinga bizokorera isuzuma nyuma y'ihyishyira mu bikorwa rya gahunda y'ibikorwa yo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu gice cy'ihyishyira mu bikorwa ry'unumushinga.

* Ibiswala mu kweenza ibikorwa by'unumushinga

* Kuri bunyi gikone ry'unumushinga, inyandiko a'agatenganyi ya gahunda y'ibikorwa yo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu gice cy'ihyishyira mu bikorwa ry'unumushinga izapuhikirwe IUCN kugira ngo inyesingene, bitye lyatangendo ibiterakero. Nyuma yo guisirambo inyandiko ya nyuma, gahunda y'ibikorwa byo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu gice cy'ihyishyira mu bikorwa ry'unumushinga izemeza inyandiko ya nyuma y'iyi gahunda y'ibikorwa ndetse

inenyeshwe abantu. Ukwemese ke'nyi gahunda y'ibikorwa ni imwe mu ngingo zohingineho muri EMSS mu kwemeza ibikorwa ndetse no gutangira kwa gahunda iz'icyihinya mu bikorwa ny'ibikorwa bato gukumira abaturage mu mitungiro yabo mu ghe cy'umushinga.

- icyihinya mu bikorwa rintanera ry'inyandiko ya gahunda y'ibikorwa na nyuma yo gukumira abaturage mu mitungiro yabo mu ghe cy'umushinga nk'ako byagagarwe hanguro (ingamba zose ku gumikora zemeranyiho zogomba kuba zihari) ni mume mu ngingo z'ingenzi zo gutangira ko mugurapemo itariki y'imorereke myica za gahunda yo gukumira abaturage mu mirima yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'unyamwe ndetse n'tingiro nga kuvungura ingamba zo gukumira zenerakore ny'ibikorwa bife inangoma zikutomwe ku gukumira abaturage mu mitungiro yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'unyamhinga.

- Raporozigara aho umushinga ugeze zigaba zikubizayo isemunyezo n'iicyihinya mu bikorwa ny'a gahunda y'ibikorwa bato gukumira abaturage mu mitungiro yabo mu ghe cy'icyihinya mu bikorwa ry'ibikorwa mu ghe cy'se icyihinya

5. Inzego zigazura unuhare mu micigire ny'ibikorwa bato gukumira abaturage mu mitungiro yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'unyamhinga

Unuhare n'iymingano mu bigendanye n'igenemigameni icyihinya mu bikorwa ndetse n'ikurikanira ny'ibikorwa bato gukumira abaturage mu mitungiro yabo mu ghe cy'unyamhinga bigewina hazingineho ku mpamvu atandutangane zigazawaga hazi. No rano kandi, bikorwa bigemije kukubasa ubuhoboko ko byanjwe n'iicyihinya mu bikorwa ny'o gukumira abaturage mu mitungiro yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'unyamhinga byarutangene.

5.1 Inzego zigashwe umushinga

Unweko rubawimisezo umushinga ni Ministere y'iBukedde binyowe mu kigo cy'igihugu gahwine Amasymayamba (RFA). Umushinga uzahyirize mu bikorwa nk'icy'igihugu gahwine Amasymayamba, IUCN Rwanda isimwe ry'i ru Rwanda, ikigo cy'ubukedde cyiteremamere n'ubutwarenene, Enabeli (gabazo ari BTC) ny'umweke rushingize icyihinya mu bikorwa ny'u vyu mushinga. Umushinga kandi ufero bafatanyakoreba batandukanye bazatinge serivisi ku bikorwa binyuruye by'unyamhinga barabo World Agroforestry Centre (ICRAF), ICCO Cooperation na World Vision Rwanda, isimwe ry'u Rwanda. Iyo miryingo weza izibhe ifanyizino inzyangirume ku ku bikorwa bitandukanye by'unyamhinga mu gukiorwa ndetse n'itso. Kuvungura ubutaka mu rwego rwo gahiyakurwa unweko ny'ubuhinzi no guhindura imberero y'abaturage mu mirara

**Page 443**

52. Nk'urengiwe nenhawi ubungenziswa ku mchinga, IUCN izakurikirana ishiriwamu bikorwa ry'umushanga, kandi ni ndyo ifite inshingano zo kukubaza na GCF bikorwa by'umushanga. IUCN ni yo ifite inshingano mu gukurikana ko ibabwane byose mu mawirizwa y'unyamusha byabuhirakwa birimo intamagire y'amasko, icangamutungu, gutango raporo. Igenzura ndetse n'andhi mabwiriza ajanye no kurengera ibidikulwe ni umutekano wa abantu mu guhe cy'ishirwa mu bikorwa ry'umushanga. Inshingano i'unyama nuthiya mu bikorwa utsumuza nyuzakwana ku bafanyame po poragurumo in ku cikuro gicura kusyo IUCN (GEF & GCF Coordination Unit, Global Finance Unit, Global Forest Programme) ndetse n'ibiro buyo mae ka Koreka ukurisabirwa n'amayejiso y'umugwane wa Africa (ESARO). Umuhazibitwa mu IUCN utshwe gikurikana ubiko ukidikulwe n'umutekano bitawabaho me gye cy'unyamusha zakurikirana kendi yemeze ughakwira y'bikorwa byo gukurimwa abaturage mu mitungo yalo mu guhe cy'umushanga, zakurikirana kandi bikorwa ndetse anemaze izi nyandiko mu rwego gutshinga galunda y'amuhagwira ku mibengo ya abagenawebizika.

53. Iigici cy'ighugu cy'amashamba kizaba gishinwe iyihiywa m bikorwanyo mu ghugu bikorwa n'amashami y'ak'i kago atandukuyenda rwego na'ugihugu, ishimi rishinwe ubuhutu n'unumuto kamere, ndetse n'andi mashimi ari ku rurwe ndimuree asinawe amashamba y'ikorwa buri mu gikorwa cya 1:1. Gukurikirana utshwe by'ibito binangwe nyihamu (kukorwa na CRAFT na IUCN Rwanda). Igikorwa cya 1:3. Gukurikirana gutahunda yo gurungura inotawemo ubwati bwihangana imhindaguiruye y'ibithe mu rwego ngo gutungura inyuma ndiizabira byingitenge (hamwe na ICRF); ndetse n'igikorwa 1:4. Ingambo za kuridza uburyo bwe kuguvirana zotakwiza hinyo no hino mu bice bitifye dvinge byinhi ho wekubwesha rinyainguka z'imhindaguiruye y'ibithe zmizy ozi u'yabutaka. Ishimi rishinwe gikurikana bikorwa by'umushanga razihayibwo mu nani.

54. Igikorcy'aghaliyo gishinwe ububanyi n'amashami n'ubwiterenewe kizagira unuhare mu gutanga ubanarabirinye mu shiriywa mu bikorwa ry'imhingafite aho ihyurwe y'amashamba mu ntara y'uburasbirakwa harimo n'uburo bw'umicungire irambye y'amashamba. Umuyango uzaba uifite inshingano ku gikorwa cya 1:2. Amashamba ny'i bwe byavugureywe ndetse bizunzeve ndeta bigimajwe icangimre irambye ndetse n'igikorwa cya 1:5. Inguzi ftinganga ibidikulwe, hakoreshejwe uburyo bw'ikorwabuhanga mu rwego ngo gutafisa urwe ng'abokora ndetse n'abaturage kugabanya igicero cy'iinkwi zicimana.

55. Unahare n'ingishango z'umicinenge y'ibikorwa byo gukurima abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ihe c'ibikorwa by umuchinga bigaragaza mu mbonerahymwe ya 4.

Imbonerahymwe ya 4: Unahare n'ingishango z'umicinenge y'ibikorwa byo gukurima abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ihe c'ibikorwa by umuchinga

| Abafatimbokwora mu mushinga | Inshingano |
|---|---|
| Urwego nyoboye rushyira mu bikorwa | Gutenga no gushyira mu bikorwa gihindha |
| Impugwe mu mberhero | Nyikoma mu rwego two gakuruma ingamba zokomoka kukubanza abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ihe cy'ibikorwa by umuchinga |
| - Bibika bonye bitifiki urwego rushyira mu bikorwa rubonobwe kukuze impamvu z'ingaruka shakuru ku gurima abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ihe cy'umushinga | - Bibika ntago nyoboye ritifiki hiti bikorwa ingamba gutera mu burye bushokisha. |

| Impugwe mu mberhero |
| Umukazi wa IUCN uzhinize ikurikanabikone n'igencura | Gukarirana ku ibikorwa mu nyakuru y'mikorene budahitwira |
| Umukazi wa IUCN uzhinize ESMS ku rwego rw'Akare | Gushingikira itegura z'ubikorwa mu bikorwa gihindha |
| - Bikorwa mu bijoyere n'ingaruka ingamba zokomoka gakurima abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ihe cy'ibikorwa by umuchinga | - Gukarirana, guzobonera gihindha mu bikorwa byo gukurima abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ihe cy'ibikorwa by umuchinga |

| Umuhuzimbokwora wa IUCN uzhinize ESMS ku rwego ne'si |
| Umubidzi wa IUCN uzhinize ESMS ku rwego Akare | Gukarirana, guzobonera, kwemwe no gatanga amakuru kuri gihindha mu bikorwa byo gukurima abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ihe cy'ibikorwa by umuchinga |

### 6. Imikorani n'Abafatanyanibikorwa by'umushinga

60. Imikorani zionebye a'Abafatanyabwirira b'umushinga ni uburyo bwiza bufasha imingendekere myija ny'iishyirwa mu bikorwa y'umushingya hamwe n'bikorwa bysyo. Iki bandi kuri uruhare rukomeye mu gukurima ibizabo by'minimbye bvsuku mu gihe cy'iishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'umushinga biturutse ku gukurima abagenawebikorwa kukera ku mutungo yabo mu gihe cy'ibikorwa by'umushingya ndetse n'imkorirenzerere y'ubutaka ibwabo.

61. Imikorani myija na abafatanyanibikorwa kuri buri bikorwa by'umushingya izagira uruhare ku kigero n'uburemene ba'ayo itiwego rushyirwa mu bikorwa umushinga ruzaageraho. Ibi birimo:

- Gusesengura ibikorwa bizigo umushinga hagamije kuruba ingakuru zishobora gituruka ku ikoma ry'i imwe mu mitungo y'abaturage nk'ibutaka kugira ngo butanganywe muri gahunda z'umushinga
- Gusesengura ingakuru zishobora giteruka n'ikomera ny'iimutingo a'yabenagewebikorwa b'umushinga ndetse no gukusanya na kigamyeze amakuru ku bantu boso bazinagweho ingakuru a'bikorwa by'umushinga
- Gushyirabo uburyo ndetse n'ingomba zionebye zigamije gukurima ibizabo bizobohora kusuka biturutse kuri gahunda a gukoma bumwe mu butaka bugitezegeri gutanganywa
- Gukurikana ndetse no gukora izisuma ny'iishyirwa mu bikorwa n'yibikorwa by'umushinga

62. Imikorani myija a'Abafatanyanibikorwa b'umushingya uburyo bewo gucungwa neza gahunda yo gukoma imwe mu mitungo yabo nk'ibutaka kugira ngo butanganywe izitwe n'iiki bikurika:

- Igabiro n'abafatanyanibikorwa kuri buri politsi yose rubwe muri gahunda z'iibikorwa by'umushinga

- Iyo uwe butaka bukorreshwa
- Utwokwo biko'abakoresha uwo mutungo
- Iyo umuntu bazanwe bakoboreseka ndetse n'umunyaro ufiteye ba nyoraho.

## Abarozi ab'ukumira: Intara y'uzaburisazwa ikuhura igikuta ubutaka bwo gukorwekuro ubwoboriro. Kubuza uwabungiro bwo gukorweka ubutaka bw'inzico n'ubutaka kuba bikorwa by'umushinga, bukohera kugira inguruka ku bwoboriro, ndetse n'ubutaka bwo kororeroamo bitwewe ka mpfite ndetse na gukorweka ubutaka bwo kororero mu kigero kini hejuru

### Abaturage baffe ubutaka buto: Nubwo ubutaka bushobora kuba bwanditswe ku muturange, ariko hari abafite ubutaka buto ku buryo butabasha kuwamo ibyishyige guto bagunyamuyungyo.

### 95. Abaturage badaffe ubutaka na bato: Ihe cyaha pahunda y'Isangamwe ny'ubutaka cyatanzse amahirwe ku bantu yo kwandikisha ubutaka bahweye. Nubwo iyi galaho yawambona ndi buryo bwo gutuma buri wese atunga ubutanga, hari byiciro by'abaturage batashitshwe gutanga ibizibazo byabo mu gite cyo kwandikisha ubutaka. Ibi bitwima hari abaturage badaffe ubutaka, abuhwo babaheshejweho no gutunga ubutaka tsingana bwe leta cyangamwe amushyamba ya lieta.

## 7. Ibura ny'abaturage bagiweho inguruka no kubuza gukorweka imungiro yabo ku kubaza bikorwa by'umushinga

69. Uburyo bw'sisenyuga buhuriweho ni bwo butama hayemekana neza umutongo kamere uzigwaho inguruka n'ikibwiza by'umushinga, aho uhenerero, hagendwe ku site zahisemo z'amutongo. Iki kandi bizinamugirwa na mukuru abo yizoridze kun site, inyangezayo ni abaturage ubwoboriro, amasanzu ukiri binyerezo inguruka byisekwele. Kiyetse uko buryo ntakwo kubantu ku butaka n'ikibwiza by'umushinga, aho umutongo yabo ndetse n'igihamba bizisera ku miberero u'abagamewenikobwa. Iki bantu rusange nziragegaza ino zingizano inguruka, nga zihari, bikorwa bw'sisenyuga bizingawaho inguruka. Hifashichwe uburyo bwe kubaza ibibazo birambaye, hayemekana amukuru ajanize nyu:

- Umubare w'ingo izimuka ndetse n'abagize umuyungyo

### Utweliwa: bw'mutongo uzigwaho ingurakundetswe inyango yabo ndetse n'andi makuru arebana nayo
