98. Ibarura rizunguwe na none amakuru ajayne n'ingirume abaturage bifuza guhabwa ndetse n'icyo bunyamongo uzumwe wete ku muthenga.

99. Amakuru yose azakusimana cyangeze agatangwa zibuka ayaagazisa abagore n'abagabo ndetse r'andi makuru y'ingencu afite aho ahunye uyu abaturage, bitemwe ny'ibyo bagrapaza bifuza.

100. Muri gahunda y'ibikorwa yo gumukira abaturage mu mitungu w'abaturage mu gihe cy'ibikorwa by'umushanga, amakuru yose azaba mu ibarura azatagwaza mu mbonerahamwe izinengweza neta kandi itanga amakuru yose y'ingencu.

101. Byongeye kandi, buri ngu ruzaba ruftie amakuru yose aagarazisa imberero y'abanyange ndetse hagrapazwe n'mitungu yawo izigwiraho inguruka na gahunda yo kubusa ubungamira ku mikorehereza y'unmutongo kamere wabo wabo. Aya makuru yose ni yo afashifhwa/zazishyowho mu gihe cye kukumva n'umuyango hagamwe guhyiraho ingamba zo gumikira inguruka zavuwe bitemwe ny'ibikorwa by'umushanga, no kugirwa ibyo buri wese yemenerwe nk'ishingiro ny'amakuru y'abanza azafasha mu igencura n'ukurikana ry'umushanga. Aya makuru yose azaba ari mpanindo twete n'yibikorwana kandi akazikwana mu ibanga mikorewe.

8. Ingamba zo gukumira inganuka zokomoka ku iburwa ny'ubuneganzira ku mutungo bitewe kamere bitewe n'ibikorwa by'umushinga

103. Gukumira inganuka haharuka ubuwo bye kurekutu kuvana muri gahunda sete/ahantu hari mu gahunda uyogutangane/vuyogunzera n'umushinga, arko hakaba hagazragaza ligerero kiri hejuru mu kuba ari ho hutunge ba nyiraha, arko ku rundi huruhare hakaliza nayintheze cyine bitewe n'ibikorwa by'mikorresherehe ikaheba na ba nyiraha. Kugira ngo ili byo bonyiwe bitwetseke kandi bikorwa we gushandu, uko muri ganjani yosemungo yosemungo nayintheze cyine kana ganjani ya gouvinshyere ibice byingatirize, arko hitabale cyine ku tekera na gukumira ko hagira byinganika binyaha mu gye ry'uburwa by'umushinga yose gouvinshyere ubwitsi bwangaritse.

104. Kweirdina inganuka hahakaliza oko hakawimeda ahantu hukudara gukurehwa a bikorokho ubutaka nabi bishobono kugorana kuco usanga ara mu ndati hakorehawa cyine bita byingakira binkoyeke. Mu rwego ngo kugaro intengo utamaze zigevehe, haba gusuburanya ahangirite ndetse no guhairiana imiberero mgye y'abaturage, umushungu watagweze ku buryo uzakalo subwa mu bidasabye ubuwo bahwimbye nate haharuka na iburwano abokoraka ubutaka bakwigishya kusoremera mu bonyi bunzize.

105. Ku bw'ibyo, ilyse umushungu witezze kugeraho bikubuye mu gice oza 1 bizakora nk'ingamba zibarwe zireba guwa abasabwa bagizwehe inganuka ku mikorresherehe y'ubutaka bwabo. (I) bibwabo ko abantu base bazaba bagizweho inganuka pu gukurimera ku mutungo wabo bazaba bagaragizeyo n'isenzangura bazaba bemerero kugwarehwa ny'ibuto by'umushinga ndetse bakaaba mu bibance mu bajenemwakorika bw'umushinga, inganuka zimunguza zikubymo: (i) kaguzera ubwiyongwe bw'mikorresherehe y'umutungo mu buryo bunyabare (ii) uburwa bonyi burundye bw'mikorresherehe y'umutungo cyinga ago umutungo uremerero na: (iii) Kaguzera ikigero cyi imilagomizi zo kubanda umutungo. Ku buryo bazaba tabatunyone umutungo wo ekwamishwa mu kulutingura yinwezi uburwo bonyi twobu bikorokho, hakazemerahe (iv) Ubitumi bururo butafusa inga gusuburanya ahangirite ndetse n'ibuto by'umushinga. (v) Kugira ngo ili byo kurekutu kuvana zogushandu, uko muri gycye intumeye yelagize mu ndati hakorehawa cyine bitwete n'ibikorwa by'mikorresherehe. Bitwete nkulo, igicye cysen korangura kwisuburanya ubutaka bwatangweyimwe y'umushingya gishobora guwara hagati vyimakya 3-5 kugira ngo hongere hahingehe biribirwa, imakya 2-3 kugira ngo hahinge hawimo, imayika 10-20 ku buri iJishyamba, hakwetseke na hokazura gubumika kudahoraho ku mutungo kamere y'abaturage.

106. Kuri ubu buryo bwabo bwitwete ko bwahalwa, ibikorwa by'umushinga buzamerera ko hakorwa igemangambye nyimbese nishingira ku ngingo nyinhi zintandukanye zimmo izibhe, izigye gito

8.1. Igamba zigimaje gukumenya mu mushinga

109. Bikorwa bikurana bitengiywe mu gahunda c'umushinga bitengaragiza ingero iyo bpu'umushinga uzupeta kwa bagenewabikorwa, ndetse binashohora kwafishishwa n'ingamba zo gukumenya bitwese bikorwa by'umushingi.

8.1.1. Kugabanya ikoresha ry'iniki binyuze mu gutanga imbubara zinondererera Bikurana

110 Umushinga uzabunda ku gutanga imbubara zinondererera bikurana nk'ako bigaragara mu gikorwa cy'umushingi cya 1.5. Ibi bikurukana ingo 100,000 zahaba Imubura zinondererera bikurana. Ibi bizigengenyo binyuze mu kugabanya ikoresheza iyrumbabara izaka yakose n'abatuye ako bikorwa by'umushingi bubi, guhoringa uburo twisa bufasha abagenewabikorwa kukona inganyuwo ntusy ngo biye mbi (ami inyamise ndetse no guhorirayo ste zibazweke zikwi beme izi mbubura mu bibe 14) itaritara y'uburovurasa. Binyuze mu gahabwa imbubara zinondererera bikurana nk'ako bigaragara mu gikorwa cy'umushingi cya 2.5. Iyi kugira ngo izidzi zabwe beme ene ababalo, icyakora ti bizobukuruza kwonokwino yizifasha zikwi beme izi mbubura nazo cilikera gukoresha iniki. icyakora umushinga uzokera isengurwa ndetse kugira ngo olusimwe ubundo bufusho bushofika kwafishisha mu gokurana buruko ubwesiyenge bw'ikoresheza ry'iniki. Hitezwe ko hakazhwa ubwesiyenge bw'ikurakana binyuze mu kuba habaho uburo bufasha abaturage kukorwana n'detse n'amatsinda/komite z'abaturage twi'imbori. Byongeye kandi,

### 8.1.3. Amahwe y'imirimo binyuze ikibwira bye kugera gutera amashyambaya

### 114. Mu gutanganye ibice y'ubuhumekero bwa pariki y'Akagera, ikyaga n'imigero hamwe n'inkengeru z'imihandira, amatunda z'imburere abaturage azahimineho nk'ibyo byasowezwabure. Abatanga seniyo z'amashyambaya nabo bazegerwa n'umushingya kugira ngo habeho kwishuta ko ku 51

115. Igikorwa cya 12.3 kigamije gufasha abantu bafite ubutaka buto ku gti cyabo mu nwego kuguruwira ahanta haweza amasimyaha yingiritshe ndetse no kugarima imisogeye myiga ruyo nk'uko bukubye guhunda yemigaye y'imisogeye y'amasimyaha. Ny'uri m'amasimyaha bazifashafa kwamborira mu matandu kgura ngi bagore ubumwe bwobumwe mu byamije n'ingiro myiga y'umafaranga, bityo kubakora ku gati buta banyuma. Ny'uri m'minu yosyo itse kuguruwira amasimyaha izabwa yakoreza z'amashikose emisogeye. Imatindwa achishwe misoguye y'amamasimyaha azangana abagennerawakirwa bwo uburyo bwo kgura ngi maziko ndetse n'uburopy bwo kugarima no guhazo amasoko manini (unigero nk'amapoto), etc.

Ubu buryo bwitwetehego gutanga umusuro ukemeye ndetse n'inyungu mu vuryo bw'amafaranga, bityo bikazareza impinduka nozo mu mibereho y'amabenerawakirwa bazaba bari muti iyi gahunda, bityo kandi bigatuma n'unmutongo uzaba wakomwe kubera ikibora byo umushinga utangwe.

116. Ikibora by'umushinga bikubye ku gici cya 2.1, 2.2 na 2.3 kigamije gufasha abahazini bafite amikoro mabe ndetse n'tsiko kubura kuva mu bunifu ngandarangano (ubuhutu gufasha gusa gufasha igi kutuba ibitwitsa), ubutese bakurira mu mikino mu buryo. Bikubura na nkubuka gokorana n'dibigi by'mikiri, bityo bakuera ka ngiro two nguko kurebwa servisi z'izigo mbiyimizi rimo kwigamijena gufasha inguzanyu, ubumwe mu kyunguro y'unmutongo y'amafaranga, byo bakabora amahireve yo kwitekeze imburu ku buryo bwagatse. Umgukwanda kungi umyogere kongerera imbaraga amastondo ya'abahino n'amkopetive, ndetse no kubishakorwa nkwinira mu mashiriyahamwe azasawwe abahino y'amashimayi mabunge (UPF), ndetse aho biiyaye ngomwba bagashinga asyo. Amasoko umusurovwa ukokoma ku noku, umusuro ukokoma ku mashimayi na bimwe mu buryo bizatanyirenye muri gahunda y'unmutongo kuko ari birimo mu bikorira bisinawe bini mu bigite ubuzima bwo bunzi bari abagize imirinyagi yo mu gace umushinga ukoreramo cyane cyane y'umikoro make, ifite ubutaka buto. Byo umaherimbo,

117.Ubunwe bwo kubona ibintu byinshwisa abagemerwbakwabwizwetwelo kubonwe binzwe mu mu tanga n'umirimvo atazangwa n'iligayo akibikera bito bizala binu muri gahunda yo gutunganya umusuro umsukuru ku bwororo bwo inzwi cyangwe ibi byino binzwe muri gahunda yo kwahingana imirimvo bubakora kubazalo. Izingayo bito byabikera bizanga uruhango mu kengene umusuro ubakwabwa ku bwororo cyangwe zinsele azanenzi baba kutumidza tranzitiko dimwe n'imo gutuzuru cyangwe gaharana ibiritshe. Mu bijanyane irifago bikera bijanye n'ubutumbiho bazimbwiro ndetse n'ubutumbhoro bwifiti, umushinga uzabafuza mu bijanyane na kubagonira ingemwe iibili.

118.Ni ngomwaba gushimangira ku bwe two gutufa abatuzurage kubuya umusuro ibikorwa by'umushinga, bigomba gakugwana ubushinziho kugra ngo hasuuzimwe ko abaturage bazaba bagwezho ingaruka binzwe ku kukwesa uberangarora ku mutungo wabo bitwero n'ibokorwaby umushinga baba mu bibazwe bigimbwa kubona amahinwe yo kubuya umusuro cyangwe kugwanaro ni izipya byo umoshinga

8.1.6.tindi ngamba zo gukurima

119.Mu ghe abaturage bazagwiraho ingaruka n'ibikorwa y'umushinga ndetse/miringayo ilife amikoro make ifite kibabuzo cuko kutagira imungwe r'ubutakura bhubwe bahalo mu buryo bw'amatzengise, kugura ngo nababo basebwa kwiyumusa ku bikorwa by'umushinga, hambua kubuka ubunyo bundi bhwamire bw'ingamba zo gukumira ibibazo byawu. N'ukurango, umushinga ushobora ushakalisa ubutabu ubune lye minyangiro kugura ngo ikoberokero ubuzinhi bw'mbwe, bivameno ibiti bijangwira n'tiyaka, cyangwe ubunyitso biri/bati byo gucana mu bubwa bila Leta busanwe bukorwehisa n'amatinda y'abaturage binyungu mu masezanero l'imikurairane amayi n'mincingame irambye uhabutika ndetse na gahunda yo kuvungura ubutaka. Aya matinda azakarena kongerera ubumeneti ndetse no gutufa abagabize kubona inyongemusanuro, kugura ku masiko, guhuza n'ibigo byo amali.

120.Gahunda yo gushirayho ingamba zo gukumira bigomba gukowwa hachingine ku isensengwa ny'amikuru ambere imbirero rusange y'abagemerwbakwora mu rwego no kumenya ibyo bakenye kuru rusha ibindi.

8.3. Imsikane iku: makuza umuntu yemwevele u'matengeko

123.Imikorane inhuweho l'abagenerwakibwora bazaba zingaziko inganuka n'ibikowira by'umuhungu nkuko bvsyobosave mu bibe bicanta, lisengese ndetse igapashashika ubantu buryo bwose bushokwa l'ngabizika za gukimura inganuka zikumbu ku kubusa ubungemiranga bw'abaturage ku mutungo yabo bibwe n'ibikowira by'umuhungu nkuko bvsyobosave huruguru.

124.Hashingive ku makuza agaragara dibhombi bushokwa ndetse ubazagsawalo inganuka bitwese n'ibikowira by'umuhungu, gahunda by'umuhungu izagaraga izwe. ibyo abamerere hakurikije amakuru uz mu mbonenherezeza za 5 nguko kura hagarekure amakuru ku mutungo ndetse ubazagsawalo inganuka bitwese n'ibikowira by'umuhungu bujije ibasalwa ndetse ibyo bemerere n'amategake hangedwe ku ngamira zemanyenihlize za gukimura. Imbonenherezeza y'makuru y'ibyo umuntu yemwevele n'amategake izagaraga neza mu burwyo bwandise muri galunda y'ibikowira, amakuru yose vingeni arambye u'ngabima za gukimura zemanyenihlize.

10. Ikurikranibikorwa no gutanga raporo

130. Gukurikirana ishyira mu bikorwa nyo gahunda zo kubusa abaturage ubunyenganisa bwe kugera ku bikorwa by'obwo bitwee nd'ibikorwa by'unumshinga MERI iyishyne no gukurikanira no gutora raporo. Ibi bizakemera ubuturo ibiwarhinyo bwe gukora ikurikranibishezo no gutanga raporo y'iishyina mu bikorwa ny'ibikorwa n'ingamba zitandukume mu bikorwa by'unumshinga na gahunda y'ibikorwa bitenganyije mu kubusa abaturage ubunyenganisa ku mutongo wabo mu gihe cy'iishyina mukorwana ny'mushinga. Gukurikanira ibikorwa byo gumiruka abaturage mu mitungu yabo kubera ibikorwa by'unumshinga bizikenera (I) ubuturo bwe gukurikanira ishyira mu bikorwa ny'ibikorwa bitenganyije muri gahunda y'Ibikorwa na (II) Gukurikanira ishyira mu bikorwa ry'ubuto bwe kunginiraga abaturage bakwore mu byabo kubera ubuturo bwe kubuswa ubunyenganisa ku mitungu yabo kubera ibikorwa by'unumshinga, kandu hagendewe ku byo bemerweze. Ibi byose bitizake bitangirwa raporo inzimo 2 hur mu meka kuri bori gikuru ni'mitami rinzhwe imicungure y'unumshinga ny'urwego rubwishye guhryira ku bikorwa umushinga. Umukozu wa IUCN uhinzehe ikurikranibikorwa nawe azaja zanginga raporo kuri bori gikoru igaragaza ingiruka zimwe guturuke kuri gahunda yo gukurima abaturage mu ku mitungu yabo kubera ibikorwa by'unumshinga.

131. Mu gihe ijemura ngarikore ko hana ibitarizege neza mu ishyira mu bikorwa mu bijanyaye na gahunda y'ibikorwa byo gumiruka abaturage ku mitungu yabo kubera ibikorwa by'unumshinga, hazaya habaho gahunda y'Ibikorwa iny'i ivuguruwe kuri bori gikoru cy'unumshinga mukorwana ny'urwego nshyira mu bikorwa umushinga ku butanye n'mukozu wa IUCN uhinzehe ikurikranibishezo kukura ngo habebo ukubuziriza ibyasalwaga byose mu igenimangambi ry'ibikorwa byo gumiruka abaturage ku mitungu yabo mu gihe cy'ibikorwa by'unumshinga ndetse


---
**Page 473**
---

n'ingamba zagamije guhanga n'ibibito byagaragaye: iyihiya mu bikorwa rya gaunda y'ikibora ikosoye izikutaramirene ubushocho kugera hagaragaye ko ibibyo baseye byari byagaragaye mbere byukumute.

132. Isuzuma nya nyuma n'iyihiywa mu bikorwa rya gaunda y'ikibora byo gakumira abaturage ku mitungu yabo bitewa ni ikibora by'umushinga nzogentera imikorere yose ndetse n'imusamuro zazaywe ku mbiyero y'abagweho ingaruka ni ikibora by'umushinga. Byo umushinga waguziye bishoboro hagaragaye ko mitungu tsetso penariye yizanake ni bikorwa byagaragaye: ibiterere y'abaturage bagizeho ingaruka ni ikibora by'umushinga. Ikibwe mu isuzuma bizagaragaye muri raporo y'apateganyi kuri buri gikore cy'umushinga ndetse no muri raporo rusange yi'ohimi rhinwase midzimungu y'umushinga.

133. Igenura nyose n'isuzuma bibirana ni iyihiywa mu bikorwa rya gaunda y'ikibora byo gakumira abaturage mu mitungu yabo mu ghe cy'iyihiywa mubikorwa nya gaunda y'umushinga rizokwara habayebo gukorana bwe hafi n'abagenemwibirwa brigezi o umushinga, by'unamhakho abantu bagwezho ingaruka no gukumira ku mitungu yabo mu ghe cy'ikibora by uusihindo kugira ngo balange bitolehero byabo ndetse ni iboboro.

134. Ikibora byose b'isuzuma n'igenzura ku bijanywe n'iyihiywa mu bikorwa rya gaunda yo kubuzza abaturage gukoresha umutungo kamere w'ahazakoreera ikibora by'umushinga bizishyinya mu bikorwa ku butafanye n'abatayabatikorwa batandukanye ku umwehako abagweho ingaruka zo kubuzza uberanganzira kuri uwo mitungo kamere, kugirango ibtekerezo byabo byumve kandi bibahwe agaciro.

11. Ingengabhe y'itegurwa n'ishyinya mu bikorwa nya gahunda y'ibikorwa

135. Ingengabhe y'itegurwa n'ishyinya mu bikorwa nya gahunda y'ibikorwa byo gukumira abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ishyinya mu bikorwa ry'umushinga izatanga umuringo ngenderwaho ku ngambo zo gukumira ibizabo boshobora kuvuka kuri buri giikwe cy'umushinga. Umugero ne'y'i nengabhe rurangaraga ku mbonerahame inagaragaza byo abafite aho bahunye n'umushinga byemweje. Buri gikorwa cyose cy'umushinga kiri muni haunda y'ibikorwa byo gukumira abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'umushinga kigaragaza amakuru y'ingamba zo guhanga n'izabazo byavuka ndetse ni impinduka zishobora kuhabo ku gikorwa runaka.

12. Gukura gahunda y'ibikorwa yingamba zo gukumira ingaruka zokomoka ku gukumira abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'umushanga

136. Kuri buni gikorwa cy'umushanga, gahunda y'ibikorwa igaragaza ingamba zo gukumira ibizabo bishobora gukomoka ku gukumira abaturage ku mitungo yabo kubera ibikorwa by'umushanga izategurwa ndetse izaba igowe ni r'iyo bice bikurika:

1. Intangiriro
2. 11. Intego wa gahunda y'ibikorwa ingamba zo gukumira ibizabo bishobora gukomoka ku gukumira abaturage ku mitungo yabo kubera ibikorwa by'umushanga
3. 12. Amakura arambaye aijapeye n'i umushanga
4. 2. Amatengeko ni'ibyo ateganya ku bijanye no kubusa abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'umushanga
5. 1. Ipo amatengiko y'u Rwanda ateganya mu bijanye n'i igicurura
6. 23. Politsiki ijyane no gukumira abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'umushanga
7. 3. Ingamba d'urweyo mu bijanye ni micingureye y'uburoyo bwo gukumira abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'umushanga
8. 4. Imikorane ndi'abatanyarwanda b'u'mushanga
9. 5. Itesegurwa ny ingamba zo gukumira ibizabo bishobora gukomoka ku gukumira abaturage ku mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa by'umushanga
10. 7. Igicurura rihiweho
11. 25. Iburrwa ny'abantu bagizewo ingaruka no gukumira abaturage ku mitungo yabo kubera ibikorwa by'umushanga
12. 6. Ingamba zo gukumira ibizabo bishobora gukomoka ku gukumira abaturage ku mitungo yabo kubera ibikorwa by'umushanga
13. 7. Ingamba zo gukumira mu bikorwa by'umushanga
14. 8. Ungamba zo gihundura imberheto y'bagenerwebakwibora b'u'mushanga
15. 9. Ibisabwa ni'ibyo umuntu yemerewe
16. 8. Ibarura ryo mu mye kumidzi ritinga amakuru akenewe
17. 7. Ingengo y'imali y'itesegurwa ny ingamba zo gukumira ibizabo bishobora gukomoka ku gukumira abaturage ku mitungo yabo kubera ibikorwa by'umushanga

8. Ikurikarabikowira n'igencura na raporo

9. Ingengabe ipiragaza itegewu ri'niriywa mu bikorwa nya gahunda y'ibikorwa byo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga

137. Buri njego vose fiteganywa muri buri cge cy'iwi nyandiko zikuzakarwira ndetse kifashishwe mu gutugura ibice bigice gahunda y'ibikorwa byo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga

- Gahunda y'ibikorwa byo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga muri buri gikone hamwe n'iranganika zakebomitoza bizaga bitanganya ni intangiriro ipiragaza intere y'iwi gahunda y'ibikorwa ndetse inasabanezwe notse amakuru yose ayimwe u'mushanga nk uti buri mu gce cge cy'iwi nyandiko

- Mu gice cya 2 kirebuka n'matekgo n'imikorene y'ibikorwa byo gumikura abaturage ku mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga muri buri gahunda y'ibikorwa ipiragaza ho hazakabera amatekgo aribwe ndetse n'matekgo afiteyane zana na politiki y'ubukidake nacu mu mitungango ne GCE ne ITCEN mukore ne politsike y'umisanga yo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga

- Mu gice cya 2.1 ni gahunda y'ibikorwa yo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga zaka izubuyemo ndetse igaragaza isengera ry'amatekgo n'imikorene bagenza mu Rwanda. By'umukoreho, hazakabera kandi amatekgo n'imikorene ifite aha furwe ne gumikura abaturage abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga kuri buri gikone cyepo cy'umisanga

- Politsike y'umisanga icyane no gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga izuba ni mu gice cge cy'iwi 2.2 cyi bunifu gahunda y'ibikorwa. Bozobonana kandi ko buri gikone cyumisanga kgabona kukubanda n'ingirango zose iteganywa muni politike icyane no gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga

- Mu gice cya 3, uburo bw'inccingere y'ibikorwa byo gumikura abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ibikorwa byo umushanga ku bikorwa runuka by'umisanga ndetse n'uruhane rwa buri webo nibago bigimira gozobonana

- Mu gice cya 4, ropro zineneba ni nkiborwa birebuka n'imikoreneza na afanayabikorwora byumisanga bizakweze mu ghe cy'itegewu nya gahunda y'ibikorwa ndetse no ripo zakaba zifite n'dini bhamya (amafoto n'amashutsho) bizashangirwaho ndetse bigaragaze mu


---
**Page 480**
---

**mugoreka. Uharwe n'ikimkone y'uburyo bwo kwakira ibibazo ku mushinga nabyo buzusanonwara kurushaho.**

- **Mupi cya 5:** Raporo zigagaraza byagazweho hagendere ko amakuru ajanye n'bikorwa ku mibereho y'abagenanobikorwa harimo n'sesengura rihuriwe hamwe ny'ibirurwa ry'abagizeho ingaruka n'bikorwa by'umushinga azachingirwaho ndetse yongerene ku mugoreka

- **Ipo cya 6:** Igiragaza amakuru arambye ajanye rinyamba zose zemeranjiweho zijanye no gumukira abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ikorwa by'umushinga, iki gice kandi giobanura uburyo bwo kwakirika no kugetra ko bwemvukane. Na none, iki gice gitanga isesengura ku ngamba zigamije guhuruda imbereho y'abagenanobikorwa by'umushinga, ndetse n'amakuru ajanye n'abagizeho ingaruka no gumukira abaturage mu mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ikorwa by'umushinga. Uburyo bwo kwemzeta amakuru Yibirura rikozwe mu mupyo ku biribana n'alanto bagizeho ingaruka no gumukira abaturage ku mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ikorwa by'umushinga nabyo bizigarazepa ndetse bisigwe ku mugoreka ya gahurunda y'bikorwa.

- **Ipo cya 7:** Gitanga ingengo y'imali ku ngamba zo gumukira muri buri gikorwa cy'umushinga

- **Ipo cya 8:** Giobanura uburyo bw'ikurikanobikorwa n'igencora no gutanga raporo ku bikorwa by'umushinga

- **Ipo cya 9:** Igiragaza amakuru y'ingengabhe by'ifugwera ry'ihuriwe mu bikorwa ry'ingamba zo gumukira abaturage ku mitungo yabo mu ghe cy'ikorwa by'umushinga kuri buri gikorwa cy'umushinga
